jobs.title: Hiring Now! Assistant Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Arellano Associates (AA) is a professional community outreach firm specializing in the transportation, clean energy, and water sectors. We bridge the gap between government agencies and the public by combining meaningful, digital and in\-person engagement with innovative technology to deliver a transparent and accessible communication process for our client's projects.  

  

By creating engagement opportunities for stakeholders to have a genuine voice in the planning and decision\-making process, we build trust, encourage collaboration, and help reduce disparities; working together toward a more connected, sustainable, and equitable California.  

  

The Assistant Project Coordinator (APC) is a full\-time, entry\-level role on the front lines of that work, supporting public outreach and stakeholder engagement for a project team under the guidance of a Project Manager. The position calls for learning agility, the ability to pick up new tools, including AI, quickly and apply them well. It also calls for ownership and follow\-through, the discipline to get the details right on a public meeting, a mailer, or a project update, since those are the details that ultimately make an impact on the communities we serve. This position is also a launchpad into a career in public outreach and project delivery, with plenty of room to grow within the company.  

  

Check out some of the Projects we are working on and how we are making an impact to communities all throughout Southern California!: https://www.arellanoassociates.com/projects  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Content Creation:** Draft written text for collateral materials including fact sheets, brochures, newsletters, posters, e\-communications, and social media content.
* **Messaging Support:** Help tailor draft content to project goals and different audiences, building an understanding of how messaging shifts depending on the community and client you're working with.
* **Event Coordination:** Support in\-person public engagement events such as public meetings, pop\-ups, and special events, including logistics, supplies, and staffing.
* **Public Interaction:** Engage directly with community members at outreach events, facilitate participation, and help gather public feedback that shapes project strategy.
* **Tech Tools \& AI:** Apply the latest tech tools, including AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, and Claude, to communicate project information and gather public input, using platforms like ArcGIS, SurveyMonkey, MetroQuest, Poll Everywhere, Typeform, Google Forms, Constant Contact, Salesforce, SharePoint, and WordPress.
* **Creative Production:** Use Adobe Creative Suite programs, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Premiere Pro, for basic file creation and editing.
* **Vendor Coordination:** Coordinate vendor services including printing, catering, translation and interpretation, and toll\-free phone lines.
* **Database \& Website Management:** Keep stakeholder databases, project websites, and social media content current and accurate.
* **Digital Engagement:** Monitor public input coming through email, project websites, helplines, and online engagement tools, and flag issues or notable responses to your project manager promptly.
* **Task Tracking:** Organize and maintain project documentation, support scheduling, and help the team track progress and coordinate resources.
* **Project Support:** Complete tasks within timeframes and budget parameters, helping ensure timely and cost\-effective delivery.
* **Issue Communication:** Communicate issues and challenges to your project manager promptly.

  

### **What We Look For:**

 **In Every Team Member*** **Learning Agility:** You take feedback well and treat the unfamiliar as something to figure out rather than avoid. This industry and role will be new to most people who take it on, so you're the kind of person who asks a clarifying question instead of guessing. You are comfortable asking questions, jumping into something new, and curious about new technologies.
* **Ownership and Follow\-Through:** You follow through on what you say you will do, whether that's a deadline on a fact sheet or a task from a morning check\-in. When something's off, whether it's a typo you caught or a vendor that fell through, you speak up early instead of hoping it resolves itself, and you take pride in getting the details right.
* **Collaboration and Mentoring:** You work well with others and know a project runs better when everyone's pulling in the same direction. You help teammates succeed, whether that's covering an event when someone's out or walking a newer team member through a process you've already learned. Ultimately, you make the people around you better at their jobs.
* **Curiosity with Technology and AI:** You're comfortable picking up new software and tools, including AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or Claude, and applying them to real tasks. Whether that's drafting a first pass at a newsletter or researching a project topic, you know good AI use means checking the work, not just accepting it.
* **Professionalism:** You represent yourself, AA, and our clients well in every interaction. From a public meeting to an internal email. You ask questions rather than guess, show up on time and prepared, and handle mistakes with maturity.

**For This Role*** **Public Interaction:** You're comfortable talking with members of the public, whether that's staffing a table at a community event, answering questions at a public meeting, or fielding a call from a concerned resident. You can translate technical project details into plain language, and you stay professional even when someone's frustrated. No professional outreach experience required, we'll help you build it.
* **Writing and Content:** You can put together a clear, accurate first draft, whether it's a fact sheet, a newsletter article, a social media post, or a project update. You take direction well on tone,

We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self\-reliance and personal growth.  

  

Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project\-access.org/success\-stories/ **The opportunity**
The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long\-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve. **What you'll do*** Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth \& Families, Health \& Wellness, and Community Building.

**Job Title: Clinical Research Coordinator III\- Oncology**


**FSLA Classification:** Non\-Exempt


**Reports to:** CRC Manager

  


**Job Summary/ Objective:**



The Clinical Research Coordinator III is responsible for supporting the management and oversight of clinical trials. This role involves working closely with a team to ensure the smooth execution of research studies under the guidance of the Investigator and CRC Manager.

  


**Essential Functions:**


***Overseeing Clinical Trials:***


* Ensure smooth conduct of study visits and clinical trials.
* Monitor study participants’ health throughout the trial.
* Schedule study visits within protocol\-required timelines
* Coordinate lab work, imaging, and other required procedures
* Document all aspects of the study visit and subject status.


***Data Collection and Analysis:***


* Collect and enter data obtained from study visits into source documents, study logs, and EMR, as well as EDC where data management personnel are not assigned.
* Assist data management team with resolution of queries


***Participant Interaction:***


* Educate study participants about study objectives and visit procedures.
* Communicate with study participants regarding any adverse events or side effects and the management of them.
* Administer applicable questionnaires.
* Monitor participants' adherence to protocol guidelines.


***Collaboration and Compliance:***


* Liaise with laboratories
* Liaise with Imaging vendors
* Liaise with pharmacy staff and infusion nurses
* Liaise with regulatory and quality assurance departments on protocol adherence and documents.
* Monitor study compliance with protocols and ethical standards.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.


***Record Keeping:***


* Maintain research records, including source documents, study logs, case report forms, and EMR
* Direct specimen collection, labeling, packaging, transport, shipping, and storage.


***Logistics and Supplies:***


* Ensure all necessary equipment and supplies are in stock and functional.


**Education/Experience/Skills:**


***Education:*** Bachelor's degree preferred in a health\-related field


***Experience***: \+3 years of experience in Clinical Research


**Skills:**


***Regulatory***


* Filing and accessing documents, Study Submission Assistant, Conduct Close\-out Visits
* Report protocol deviations and SAEs to the IRB (where not performed by the Research Navigator)


***Finance***


* Stipend payments
* Manage site budgets
* Insurance Coordination


***Subject Interaction***


* Recruit, interview, screen, enroll, and randomize subjects
* Obtain Informed Consent
* Collect medical history
* Conduct study visits
* Triage patients' questions


***Administrative***


* Source documentation
* EDC completion
* Query resolution
* AE/SAE documentation and reporting
* Address protocol violations and deviations
* Order/ maintain supplies


***Clinical Skills***


* Phlebotomy preferred
* Vital Signs
* EKG
* Order and organize lab reports
* IP Administration
* Manage Medical Records


***Others***


* Support training and answer questions of other staff members
* Support monitoring visits
* Leads sponsor communication
* Manage subject visits during managers’ absence
* Liaise with Investigators in manager’s absence


**Working Conditions/ Physical Demands:**  

Standard operating hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. May be required to complete job\-related tasks outside of that time frame more than a standard 40\-hour work week. jobs.title: Logistics Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

POVISON is seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Logistics Operations Coordinator to support our U.S. logistics operations, with a primary focus on Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC), final\-mile, and white\-glove delivery performance.

Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English is **REQUIRED** for this position due to regular communication and coordination with POVISON's China\-based team.

This role is responsible for monitoring shipments from warehouse dispatch through final delivery, coordinating with warehouses and carriers, proactively identifying transportation risks, resolving delivery exceptions, and supporting successful delivery execution.

The Logistics Operations Coordinator will work closely with U.S. Operations, warehouses, carriers, finalmile delivery teams, internal support teams, and POVISON's China\-based team to ensure issues are identified early and driven through resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and monitor the end\-to\-end post\-shipment process for DTC orders, from warehouse dispatch through successful final delivery.
* Track shipment and delivery status throughout the transportation process and maintain visibility of open or at\-risk orders.
* Monitor warehouse and carrier exceptions in real time, including pickup delays, transit delays, prolonged tracking inactivity, damaged shipments, lost shipments, and delivery failures.
* Proactively identify orders at risk of becoming service exceptions based on shipment milestones, tracking activity, historical trends, and carrier performance.
* Take preventive action by communicating with warehouses, carriers, final\-mile providers, and internal teams before issues escalate.
* Coordinate POVISON's final\-mile and white\-glove home delivery operations, including delivery scheduling, access concerns, address issues, product questions, reschedules, returns, and delivery exceptions.
* Manage transportation and delivery exceptions including damaged or missing products, customer refusals, unable\-to\-fit situations, incomplete deliveries, unsuccessful delivery attempts, and assembly or installation concerns.
* Ensure appropriate photos, notes, tracking information, and supporting documentation are collected when necessary.
* Maintain ownership of open exceptions and drive issues toward resolution while providing timely updates to the appropriate teams.
* Respond to logistics\-related requests including address changes, expedited delivery requests, shipment intercepts, and other delivery needs.
* Communicate and coordinate regularly with POVISON's China\-based team in Mandarin and English regarding shipment status, inventory questions, product concerns, damages, delivery exceptions, and issue resolution.
* Utilize shipment tracking data and carrier performance information to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for operational improvement.
* Maintain accurate logistics records and provide Operations leadership with visibility into shipment performance, delivery issues, and unresolved exceptions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Fluent in Mandarin Chinese and English – REQUIRED
* Bachelor's degree or above.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in both Mandarin and English.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and commonly used formulas/ functions.
* Ability to independently draft professional business communications regarding shipment exceptions, logistics inquiries, carrier issues, and delivery updates.
* Strong analytical, logical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify potential risks from shipment tracking data and operational trends.
* Proactive approach to problem\-solving with a strong sense of urgency, ownership, and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple shipments and exception cases simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong cross\-functional coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with warehouses, carriers, delivery teams, internal departments, and international teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in Logistics Management, Supply Chain, Statistics, Accounting, E\-Commerce, Business, or a related field.
* Previous experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, e\-commerce, or final\-mile delivery.
* Experience in cross\-border e\-commerce or Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC) operations.
* Experience with furniture, home delivery, or white\-glove final\-mile delivery.
* Experience working directly with warehouses, carriers, and international teams.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Event Operations
jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW**



The Los Angeles Football Club (LAFC) is an MLS soccer club serving the greater Los Angeles area. LAFC is dedicated to building a world\-class soccer club that represents the diversity of Los Angeles and is committed to delivering an unrivaled experience for fans. LAFC's ownership group is comprised of local leaders and innovators of industry with intellectual capital, financial prowess, operations expertise, and success in the fields of entertainment, sports, technology, and media. LAFC is invested in the world's game and Los Angeles, constructing, and developing the 22,000 seat BMO Stadium and a top\-flight training center on the campus of Cal\-State Los Angeles.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Coordinator, Event Operations is responsible for assisting in general tasks required to run, maintain, and service the stadium and/or events. This position will also act as a liaison between the facility and clients, ensuring all clients' requirements are met, and facility rules, regulations, and policies are adhered to.



This role will be expected to work approximately 20% of the time overnight but may be subject to change depending on business needs.



This role reports to the Manager, Event Operations.


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**


* Coordinate and ensure completion of maintenance and repairs received from stadium Operations leadership.
* Contribute to training and coordinating part\-time operations crew in the completion of general tasks to service the stadium and/or events.
* Coordinate and facilitate operations related requirements and requests from various departments and contractors to ensure the facility is ready for each event.
* Support the installation and dismantle of various conversion equipment, including but not limited to, staging, temporary flooring, trussing, demountable seating, and chair set/strike.
* Regularly attend event planning meetings to ensure the Operations Department receives pertinent information to appropriate staff and prepare the facility for upcoming events.
* Partner with all applicable departments to provide clear, concise, and timely communications regarding event requirements and requests.
* Assist the department in tracking and accounting for inventory and all stadium equipment on a regular basis.
* Conduct periodic facility walk throughs to identify maintenance issues and provide solutions.
* Assist with the development and implementation of preventative maintenance schedules, departmental standard operating procedures, emergency procedures, and risk/safety policies are being adhered to and compliant with all governmental regulations including but not limited to Cal/OSHA.
* Other duties as assigned by Supervisor/Management.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Facilities Management, or related field from an accredited College or University preferred, or an equivalent combination of 3 – 5 years of training, experience, and education.
* Minimum of 1\-2 years' experience in arena or stadium operations required, preferably at a high\-volume location.
* Working knowledge of practices and procedures related to events, facility conversion, and maintenance of equipment.
* Ability to understand and work from general instructions, specifications, blueprints, sketches, event documents, and preventative maintenance schedules.
* Ability to build and maintain working relationships with peers, clients, exhibitors, patrons, and others encountered throughout the course of employment.
* Detail oriented with an ability to multi\-task and meet strict deadlines.
* Strong communication skills – both written and verbal.

The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at the Keck School of Medicine of USC is seeking a detail\-oriented and highly motivated Research Coordinator I to support clinical trials and observational research in Alzheimer's disease, related dementias, and neurodegenerative disorders.


Working directly under the supervision of Dr. Lon Schneider, Professor of Psychiatry, Neurology, and Gerontology, the Research Coordinator I will support the day\-to\-day coordination of study activities, including participant recruitment, regulatory documentation, and data management. The successful candidate will be able to work independently on assigned responsibilities, maintain high\-quality study documentation, support ongoing monitoring, and audit readiness, and contribute to improved regulatory and operational processes across the research program.

* Coordinate assessments, tests, and other assigned clinical trial activities to meet research objectives and study protocol compliance.
* Support participant recruitment, screening, eligibility tracking, orientation, scheduling, and correspondence.
* Collect, record, manage, and analyze data for research studies. Prepare and submit accurate, complete, and timely reports according to project schedules or on an ad hoc basis.
* Maintain regulatory documentation, including submissions, amendments, and informed consent, in compliance with FDA, GCP, IRB, HIPAA, SOPs, sponsor and institutional policies.
* Prepare sites for sponsor monitor visits and internal reviews, quality assurance checks, and audit\-readiness activities.
* Organize project\-related meetings and events to increase knowledge about clinical trials and regulations. Provide ongoing guidance to research personnel and study participants to maintain compliance.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The University reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree (in life sciences, health sciences, pharmacy, psychology, neuroscience, public health, regulatory science, clinical research, or a related field) or equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Proficiency with MS Office applications
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Experienced Clinical Research Coordinator - Long Beach
jobs.description:
Healthy Brain Clinic in Long Beach, CA is part of the Irvine Clinical Research site network, the largest of its kind on the West Coast. With 5 research centers in California, we are leaders in the search for new treatments in neurology, psychiatry, and obesity medicine. Our largest area of research is in Alzheimer’s Disease prevention and treatment drug trials, and our doctors were the largest contributors in the world to the most recently FDA\-approved medication in Alzheimer’s Disease.

We are seeking a dedicated and experienced **Clinical Research Coordinator** to drive trial success at our Long Beach location. This role is ideal for a seasoned CRC (internally leveled as a CRC II, III, or IV depending on experience) who is ready to take ownership of complex Phase II and III clinical trials. You will work closely with our Principal Investigators and clinical team to ensure the highest standards of data integrity, patient safety, and operational excellence.
### **Job Duties**

* **Study Management:** Serve as the primary or co\-coordinator for assigned Phase II/III clinical research studies, overseeing day\-to\-day operations from site initiation to closeout.
* **Protocol Compliance:** Execute study procedures with strict adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines, FDA regulations, and specific study protocols.
* **Patient Coordination:** Guide participants through complex visit schedules, including consenting, screening, and coordinating cross\-functional appointments (e.g., imaging, infusions).
* **Data Integrity:** Timely and accurately enter, organize, and maintain study data across various electronic platforms (eSource, EDC, CTMS), proactively resolving queries.
* **Clinical Assessments:** Conduct vital signs, ECGs, and other protocol\-specific diagnostic, efficacy, and safety assessments.
* **Quality \& Audit Readiness:** Maintain impeccable regulatory and source documentation, ensuring the site is consistently prepared for sponsor monitoring visits and audits.

### **Job Requirements**

* **Experience:** 2 to 4\+ years of hands\-on experience coordinating industry\-sponsored clinical trials (prior experience in CNS, Neurology, or Psychiatry is a strong plus).
* **Technical Skills:** Demonstrated ability to navigate complex clinical trial management systems (CRIO eSource \& CTMS) and EDC platforms quickly and accurately.
* **Organization \& Precision:** Exceptional attention to detail, capable of managing competing priorities and complex visit windows without compromising quality.
* **Communication:** A strong, professional command of spoken and written English, with a proven ability to build rapport with older adult populations and their study partners.

**Hours and Compensation**
* **Location:** This is a full\-time employment position based in\-person at our Healthy Brain Clinic / Long Beach site in Long Beach: 1703 Termino Ave, Ste 201, Long Beach, CA 90804
* **Compensation:** The expected salary range for this position is **$30\-40 per hour** (**$62,400 to $83,200 per year**). *Final compensation offers will be determined based on the candidate's specific internal level (CRC II \- IV), years of relevant clinical trial experience, and applicable clinical certifications (e.g., CCRC, nursing, or phlebotomy license).*
* **Insurance:** The company covers 100% of employee\-only premiums for our baseline Gold HMO health plan, plus dental and vision coverage.
* **Paid Time Off:** Vacation (PTO) is earned at a rate of **3 weeks per year**.
**Equal Opportunity \& Fair Chance Employer** *Healthy Brain Clinic and its affiliates are Equal Opportunity Employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

jobs.title: RETAIL PRE-PRODUCTION COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**



The Retail Pre\-Production Coordinator is an integral part of Global Merchandises’ supply chain. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in organization, multi\-tasking, self\-management, and strong communication skills. This role is to ensure that Global can efficiently track \& monitor all styles in sampling while setting manageable priorities with our vendors \& internal team to push for timely approvals.



Exceptional critical thinking with the ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple projects with overlapping deadlines is essential for this role. A substantial working knowledge of Microsoft Excel is necessary. The ability to take instruction is paramount, along with the timely management of a varied workload, with pressing deadlines and priorities.



This individual must be highly efficient, dedicated to the task at hand and must be able to communicate effectively, have the tenacity to problem\-solve and work as a team player. This individual submits samples to our licensors for alignment and approval.



This is a critical part of our licensed merchandise process and must be handled quickly and effectively to ensure targets are met. The Pre\-Production Coordinator is responsible for all new development that goes into sampling. Pre\-Production Coordinator must keep track of and communicate any foreseeable production challenges to respective teams and offer solutions.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES**


* Work closely with Production Manager, along with sales \& creative, to ensure all samples are executed correctly \& in a timely fashion.
* Create \& maintain all item set ups when sales team requests new items to assign style numbers.
* Handle Purchase Order Form (POF) requests from sales team \& coordinate with creative team to collect art links/SEP files. Push and set priorities internally with creative team for art links/SEP files. Information needs to be organized in the creative tracker \& sample tracker.
* Manage sample inventory, tracking product \& hitting deadlines.
* Working with manufacturers/vendors to resolve issues during the sample process.
* Provide feedback and continued liaison for required revisions/re\-samples with vendors, keeping sales managers \& production team updated throughout process.
* Maintain \& update sample tracker WIP to keep all sampling organized and follow up with vendors in a timely fashion. Manages workflow, prioritizing consistent follow through with factories on proto and pre\-production sampling.
* Set sampling priorities with vendors based on PO’s and desired deliveries.
* Send out weekly WIPS to vendors to push for all updates on sample ETA’s (Estimated time of Arrival) and DDD’s (Drop Dead Date – for approval).
* Share art links/SEP files with allocated vendor after creative distributes to team.
* Collect all sample images from vendors and send off for brand manager/licensor approval upon receipt (time sensitive) after creative signs off.
* Communicate approval comments and corrections to internal and external channels; trackers, factories/vendors, and partners as applicable.
* Coordinate all sample tracking from vendors and ship physical samples to retailers.
* Review sample requests and identify any sampling/production concerns and provide possible solutions. Communicate necessary information to respective teams.
* Brainstorm new processes that promote efficiencies with order ingestion.
* Handle ad\-hoc duties as they arise \& assist with other projects as needed.


**JOB QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS**


* Bachelor’s Degree (Preferred) or equivalent work experience
* Must have the ability to multi\-task and prioritize in a fast\-paced, time\-pressured environment.
* Outstanding verbal \& written communications skills and able to liaise internally with various teams such as production/sales/brand mgmt. and externally with manufacturers/vendors/customers.
* Trained eye for the elements of design: ie. color, proportion, and balance as well as aesthetic detail. Pantone color experience is a plus.
* Ability to self\-manage/work independently, demonstrable leadership and stress management skills.
* Multitask, highly motivated, positive, and strong work and team ethics. Critical thinking with the ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple projects with overlapping deadlines.
* Excellent time management and organizational skills, along with the ability to prioritize and possess a sense of urgency when appropriate.
* Basic knowledge of license apparel a plus.
* Demonstrable experience in a similar role.
* Experience working in timeline driven environments.
* Knowledge and experience using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator programs.
* Experience in Screen Printing \& Embroidery (Preferred)
* Experience in Microsoft Suite \& Google Suite

* Ability to sit, stand, and move around the office environment for extended periods.

* Ability to reach with hands and arms to access files, equipment, and workstations.

jobs.description:
**About Toll Group**

At Toll, we do more than just logistics \- we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 27 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries. We are proudly part of Japan Post — www.tollgroup.com


**PRIMARY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead and manage end\-to\-end ocean freight operations for import/export, including booking, documentation, and dispatch for high\-value or complex shipments.
* Act as the primary point of escalation for operational issues, ensuring timely resolution and customer satisfaction.
* Liaise with shipping lines, customs brokers, transport providers, flexitank suppliers, depots, warehouses, and other service providers to ensure efficient cargo movement and regulatory compliance across containerized freight and specialized transportation solutions.
* Review and approve critical documentation such as bills of lading, customs declarations, and regulatory paperwork.
* Monitor shipment milestones, proactively identify risks, and communicate delays or disruptions to customers and stakeholders with solutions.
* Coordinate and optimize end\-to\-end transportation solutions, including containerized freight, flexitank shipments, tank container movements, warehousing, transloading, and domestic transportation.
* Oversee job management including WIPS, accruals, cost control, and timely closures; ensure financial accuracy and compliance.
* Validate and approve customer invoices, reports, and creditor payments; identify opportunities for cost optimization and margin improvement.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and ensure timely updates in internal systems (e.g., CargoWise One).
* Ensure adherence to customs, quarantine, and maritime regulations; provide guidance on compliance matters.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through proactive communication and service excellence.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives, system enhancements, and operational best practices.
* Mentor and support junior coordinators, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance team environment.
* Demonstrate commercial awareness by analysing job profitability and supporting strategic decisions to enhance financial performance.
* Provide operational oversight and risk management for specialized transportation solutions, including flexitank and tank container shipments.

**PREVIOUS WORK EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5\-7 years' experience in ocean freight operations, including import, export, and domestic transportation activities.
* Experience managing complex supply chain solutions, including containerized freight, transloading, warehousing, and specialized cargo movements.
* Experience managing flexitank shipments, tank containers, beverage logistics, wine logistics, or other specialized ocean freight solutions is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of ocean transportation, customs regulations, carrier requirements, documentation, and operational risk management.
* Familiarity with freight management systems and Microsoft Office.
* Strong organisational and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Detail\-oriented with a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* Team player with a proactive and customer\-focused approach.

jobs.title: Inside Sales & Service Representative
jobs.description:
Hajoca Corporation is one of the country’s largest privately\-held wholesale distributors of plumbing, heating \& cooling, and industrial supplies. Founded in 1858, Hajoca is a company based on the principles of “Service, Integrity, Reliability,” and on relationships of trust and support with teammates, customers, and suppliers. Throughout its history, Hajoca has played an active role in shaping advances in plumbing. However, we attribute our success to two simple truths; a unique business philosophy and talented people. Hajoca is all about the people, who give us our advantage, and who will guide us successfully into the future.
  
  

Although Hajoca is a large company, we work in a decentralized environment where each of our locations, called Profit Centers (PCs), is run by the Profit Center Manager as if it were their own small business. A typical Profit Center is the heart of our business and consists of a warehouse, counter, sales office, and (sometimes) a showroom. Our PCs conduct business under unique trade names and offer a customized business approach, honoring what’s special about each local marketplace.
  
  

Hajoca is one of those trade names and is looking for an Inside Sales \& Service Representative at their Los Angeles, CA location.
  
  

Pay for Inside Sales \& Service Representative is between $25 and $35 per hour at this location.
  
  

Do you take pride in providing an excellent customer experience? Are you outgoing, knowledgeable, and service\-oriented? Do you have the determination to close sales and build lasting relationships with new and existing customers? If so, we’d like you to join our team as an Inside Sales \& Service Representative.
  
  

**About the Role:**  

**You will:**  

* Meet or exceed the sales targets established by your Manager.
* Work with the Profit Center Manager to establish revenue and margin targets.
* Accurately process Sales Orders and Bids generated through telephone sales transactions.
* Assist customers who pick up their order at our Profit Center.
* Find innovative ways to grow sales with existing customers and become their trusted advisor.
* Generate sales leads that develop into new customers.
* Identify opportunities for value\-added services and articulate our solutions.
* Investigate and resolve customer problems, address pricing deductions and material returns timely and in accordance with Company policy and procedure, and follow up to ensure resolution and customer satisfaction.
* Support Counter and Outside Sales activities and all Profit Center activities as part of our Profit Center team.

**About You:**

**Our ideal candidate will also:**  

* Effectively use Microsoft Office software (Outlook, Word, Excel) to communicate via email, to maintain weekly sales plans, call reports, and customer contact files, and to analyze customer data.
* Demonstrate outstanding customer service, telephone/verbal communication, and generous listening skills.
* Demonstrate product knowledge to answer customer questions and identify opportunities to upsell or cross sell.
* Build influential relationships and trust with customers and vendors through open and interactive communication.

**The benefits of working with us:**  

Our culture is well\-suited for exceptional people who use their talents to drive business and want to share in the financial success their efforts yield. In addition to a competitive starting wage, we offer a Profit\-Sharing Program that provides each team member with an opportunity to earn a direct share of the profits on an annual basis. In addition to our generous compensation package, Hajoca also offers:

* Medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage
* Accident, Hospital Indemnity, and critical care coverage

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Specialist – Paid Ads, Sales Growth & Livestream Strategy
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Longevity Nutra, Inc. is seeking a **results\-driven, hands\-on Performance Marketing Specialist** to manage paid advertising and help drive measurable, profitable sales growth across our eCommerce business.

Our primary advertising platforms include **Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube**.

This is not a role focused simply on generating clicks, views, or engagement. We are looking for someone who understands how to turn advertising spend into **customer acquisition, sales, revenue, and sustainable growth**.

The ideal candidate can personally manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns while also thinking beyond the ad account — developing ideas for **offers, promotions, sales campaigns, retargeting strategies, livestream campaigns, creative concepts, and customer acquisition strategies** that can improve overall sales performance.

Our current customer base is primarily **Vietnamese\-speaking consumers in the U.S.**, while one of our key growth priorities is expanding into the broader **U.S. consumer market**. The successful candidate will help strengthen sales within our existing market while developing, testing, and scaling strategies to reach new U.S. customers.

**Vietnamese language ability is highly preferred but not required.**

**Primary Objective**

The primary objective of this position is to use paid media and performance marketing to generate **measurable and profitable sales growth**. Success in this role will be evaluated based on business outcomes such as:

* Revenue generated from paid advertising
* ROAS
* CPA / CAC
* Conversion rate
* Customer acquisition volume
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Campaign profitability
* Ability to successfully test and scale winning campaigns

We value reach, engagement, and traffic when they contribute to the customer journey — but **sales performance and profitable customer acquisition are the ultimate goals.** 

**What You’ll Own**

**Paid Advertising \& Revenue Growth**

* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across **Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube**
* Take day\-to\-day ownership of campaign performance and advertising budgets

* Optimize campaigns for conversions, customer acquisition, revenue, and profitability — not simply traffic or engagement
* Monitor and improve **ROAS, CPA, CAC, conversion rate, AOV, and revenue**
* Identify winning campaigns and scale them responsibly
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and take corrective action
* Allocate advertising budgets based on measurable performance and growth potential

**Sales \& Promotional Strategy**

* Work with management to develop **sales campaigns, promotional offers, bundles, limited\-time promotions, and customer acquisition strategies**

* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross\-selling, bundles, and retargeting
* Develop strategies for acquiring new customers and re\-engaging previous customers
* Recommend when to scale, modify, pause, or replace campaigns based on results

We want someone who can contribute ideas and say:

**“Here is the audience. Here is the offer. Here is the creative angle. Here is how we should advertise it. Here is how we measure whether it worked.”**

**Livestream \& Social Commerce Strategy**

* Help develop advertising and promotional strategies to support **livestream selling**
* Work with our internal team to create campaigns that drive customers to livestream events
* Develop pre\-live, live, and post\-live advertising strategies
* Recommend livestream offers, bundles, promotions, and calls\-to\-action
* Retarget viewers and engaged audiences after livestream events
* Analyze livestream campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement

**This position is not required to be the on\-camera livestream host.** The focus is on developing and optimizing the marketing and sales strategy behind livestream campaigns.

**Audience \& Market Expansion**

* Develop advertising strategies for both **Vietnamese\-speaking and broader U.S. consumer audiences**
* Strengthen customer acquisition within our existing Vietnamese\-speaking market
* Develop and test strategies to expand into the broader U.S. market
* Build prospecting, retargeting, lookalike, and audience segmentation strategies
* Adapt creative concepts, messaging, offers, and targeting based on different consumer audiences
* Identify new audience and market opportunities through campaign data

**Creative Strategy \& Testing**

* Develop structured testing plans for **creative concepts, hooks, messaging, offers, audiences, and ad formats**
* Identify which advertisements and creative elements are generating **sales — and why**
* Translate campaign performance into actionable recommendations for our creative team
* Collaborate with our internal team on **video ads, image ads, short\-form content, promotional creatives, and livestream content**
* Identify winning creatives and develop new testing variations
* Establish a repeatable process for testing and scaling successful advertising concepts

**Analytics, Tracking \& Optimization**

* Monitor campaign tracking, attribution, pixels, and analytics
* Work with **Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and related tools**
* Analyze the full customer journey:

**Ad → Landing Page → Product → Checkout → Sale**

* Determine whether performance issues originate from **media, audience, creative, messaging, offer, pricing, landing page, or conversion funnel**
* Track revenue and customer acquisition performance by campaign

The Head Coach is expected to role model all of the qualities and attributes of an exceptional coach – the Head Coach is expected to coach an average of eleven (11\) classes per week. Responsible for delivering a best in class experience, setting the standards for other coaches to aspire to. The Head Coach provides a high level of coach development, giving consistent feedback to their team with the ability to provide support in\-studio throughout new coach trainings.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager (contract)
jobs.description:
We're looking for a hands\-on Social Media Manager \- a creator and strategist who makes things, not a calendar manager. Your job is to produce short\-form content basically every day and turn everything happening around The Realest into content people can't scroll past.


We have an incredible amount of natural content already. Between our founder, the merchandise, the auctions, the athletes and artists, our partners, our customers, and everything happening around the business, you won't have to manufacture much. The job is to recognize the story fast, frame it the right way, shoot and edit it, and get it out. You'll spot it, capture it, package it, and publish it \- quickly.


This is a role built on speed, autonomy, and experimentation. We'd much rather you test ten smart ideas than overthink one for a week. Individual posts that don't land are completely fine, that's the cost of moving fast and learning what works.  

  

**This starts as a contract role with the potential to convert to full\-time down the line.**

 **Create great content, every day**

* Produce short\-form video daily \- recognize the story quickly, frame it, shoot it, edit it, and ship it
* Turn the natural content around us into gold: merchandise, auctions, athletes and artists, partners, customers, and live moments
* Concept, capture, and edit from start to finish — Reels, TikToks, Shorts, Stories, graphics, and real\-time content that feels native to each platform
* Keep the voice unmistakably The Realest — real, in\-the\-know, and made for collectors

**Partner on founder\-led content**

* Work closely with our founder, who's naturally one of the faces of the business
* Spot opportunities for founder\-led content that feels authentic \- never forced, never generic "CEO content"

 **Tell customer and collector stories**

* Fluent in collectible culture, with a home base on X. Comfortable across all platforms, but especially dialed into X, where the collectors are and the conversation happens \- engaging and jumping into the discussions daily, not just posting.
* Catch the reactions when collectors receive their items, and the moments with athletes and partners

**Build formats, not just posts**

* When something works, turn it into a repeatable format, template, or franchise rather than treating every post as a one\-off
* Develop recurring series that give The Realest a recognizable rhythm and identity

**Experiment, measure, and lean in**

* Try a lot, watch what performs, understand why, and double down on what's working
* Stay extremely aware of internet culture, formats, and what's landing — but translate it through an elevated The Realest lens. We should feel current and fast without chasing every meme or trend
* Track views, saves, shares, and follower growth, and turn the numbers into your next move

**Run creator and influencer engagement (secondary)**

* Identify and work with creators, influencers, and brand ambassadors who fit our mission \- a meaningful part of the role, but always secondary to creating great content ourselves

 **Requirements** **Who You Are**

* A maker first — you see the post before you pick up the phone, and you'd rather ship than sit on an idea
* Fast and autonomous: you spot the story and run with it without waiting for a brief
* Fluent in internet culture and where attention is going, with the taste to filter it through an elevated brand lens
* Equal parts creative and analytical — you love a good hook and a good data point
* Someone who genuinely gets why memorabilia matters to the people who collect it

 **What We're Looking For**


Honestly, we care much more about taste, instincts, and great work than about checking traditional experience boxes. We're not counting years.

* **A strong portfolio of short\-form content you've personally shot and edited — this is what matters most**
* Hands\-on craft across filming and editing, with tools like Adobe Premiere, CapCut, or whatever gets you there (phone\-first is fine — we care about the eye, not the gear)
* Fluency across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and Facebook \- the tools, the culture, and how each platform's algorithm actually works
* An instinct for formats and franchises \- you recognize a repeatable idea when you see one
* Comfort with analytics (native platform insights, Google Analytics, and similar) and the instinct to act on what they tell you
* **Based in or around Los Angeles and able to be on\-site, with flexibility to travel for key events**
* A genuine interest in sports, music, or movie memorabilia \- you should get why this stuff matters

**ROOFCORP of America \| Anaheim, CA (on\-site) \| Full\-time, 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Monday–Friday** **Pay: $28\.00–$34\.00 per hour (non\-exempt, overtime eligible) \+ benefits**

About us

ROOFCORP of America has been repairing, restoring, and replacing commercial flat roofs since 1985\. We work in TPO, built\-up roofing, and silicone restoration for building owners and property managers across California, Oregon, Washington, and Alaska. We are a family\-run company with a simple standard: do honest work, do it right, and take care of the customer. Quality here is personal, not a department.

Our Anaheim office runs our Pacific Southwest operations. This is a working office — steady volume, real deadlines, and a team that supports each other.

The role

The Sales Coordinator is the hub of our sales operation. Our estimators are out on roofs and our sales team is in front of customers — you are the person who makes sure nothing behind them falls through the cracks. Proposals go out on time, bids get submitted before the deadline, follow\-ups actually happen, and our customer records are accurate.

If you like order, deadlines, and being the person everyone relies on, you will do well here.

What you'll do

Take in incoming leads, service calls, and bid invitations, and log every one of them accurately the same day.

Build and format roof condition reports and proposals from estimator field notes and photos — clean, professional, and error\-free before they reach a customer.

Schedule roof inspections and estimator appointments, and coordinate routing so field time is used well.

Follow up on outstanding proposals on a set schedule and keep the pipeline current so leadership always knows where every opportunity stands.

Maintain customer and project records: contacts, insurance certificates and contract documents.

Coordinate daily with our Anaheim field team, our Seattle sales leadership, and our back\-office team in Bogotá, Colombia.

Produce weekly pipeline and sales activity reports for the Sales Manager.

What you need

* 2\+ years in a sales coordination, estimating support, project administration, or inside\-sales support role. Construction, roofing, or another trade is a strong plus.
* Excellent written English. You will be preparing documents that go directly to building owners and property managers.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel and Word. Comfortable learning new software quickly.
* Genuine attention to detail. In this seat, a wrong address or a missed deadline costs real money.

**Preferred:** Bilingual English/Spanish. Experience with CRM systems or commercial property management customers.

Send your resume to martha@roofcorp.com

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Sales, travel, and happy pets too.**

We are looking for a Territory Sales Representative in Southern California to join our high performing sales team.


Working in the assigned Territory: Southern California and Hawaii, you will represent Champion Petfoods, maker of premium ORIJEN® and ACANA® foods, to retail and distribution partners. It goes without saying, this is a high visibility role.


The Territory Sales Representative (TSR) is responsible for executing Champion Petfoods' sales strategy within an assigned territory by growing sales, expanding distribution, strengthening retailer relationships, and delivering excellent in\-store execution of the ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands.


Working closely with retailers, distributors, and the Regional Sales Manager, the TSR contributes to territory growth through effective account management, product education, merchandising, and sales execution.


This position is open to candidates who currently reside in Los Angeles County, Orange County, or Northern San Diego County.  



  

**What a typical day looks like:**

**Sales \& Territory Management**

* Execute territory plans aligned with regional sales objectives.
* Grow sales and distribution within existing retail accounts.
* Identify and pursue new account opportunities.
* Maintain consistent account coverage based on territory priorities.
* Monitor competitor activity, pricing, and market trends.

**Retail \& Distributor Partnership**

* Build strong relationships with retailer and distributor partners and CPF Distributor managers.
* Conduct joint sales calls and ride\-alongs with distributor representatives.
* Support distributor sales efforts through product education and field collaboration.
* Deliver business\-building recommendations to retail partners.

**Merchandising \& Execution Excellence**

* Ensure Champion merchandising standards are maintained in all priority accounts.
* Increase brand visibility through displays, secondary placements, signage, and promotional execution.
* Monitor assortment, shelf placement, and pricing compliance.
* Address execution gaps and follow through on corrective actions.

**Training \& Brand Advocacy**

* Conduct product training and education sessions for retail associates and distributor teams.
* Represent Champion Petfoods at industry, retailer, and consumer events.
* Serve as a passionate ambassador for ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands.

**Administration \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate CRM records and sales activity reporting.
* Complete expenses, reports, and administrative tasks within established deadlines.
* Provide regular territory updates, opportunities, and market insights to the Regional Sales Manager.

**Background \& Experience:**

* Outside sales experience ideally within the pet specialty industry, consumer packaged goods/retail experience is a plus.
* Proven ability to build and maintain relationships.
* Must be able to handle, manage and overcome objections encountered within the sales process.
* Remote team collaboration with a proactive, results\-driven mindset.
* Proven experience using MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint along with a CRM program.
* Experience presenting to large and small groups.
* Flexibility to travel on average 50% within territory, with overnights required
* Availability for work events on evenings and weekends as needed
* Occasionally, be able to lift and/or carry up to 40lbs.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Sales Performance**

* Territory sales growth versus target
* New account acquisition
* Growth of key retail accounts

**Distribution**

* New SKU placements
* Distribution gains across priority accounts
* Assortment expansion

**Retail Execution**

* Merchandising compliance
* Display placement and promotional execution
* Territory coverage achievement

**Customer Development**

* Retail training sessions completed
* Distributor ride\-alongs completed
* Customer relationship effectiveness

**Operational Excellence**

* CRM compliance
* Timely reporting and administration
* Budget and expense management adherence

**Success Profile**

* Strong relationship\-building and communication skills
* Results\-oriented with a proactive mindset
* Organized and able to manage territory priorities effectively
* Comfortable presenting and training individuals or groups
* Passion for customer service, sales execution, and continuous learning

**Accountability Statement**

Success in this role is measured by achievement of sales goals, distribution growth, execution excellence, customer engagement, and effective territory management. The TSR is expected to take ownership of their territory, consistently execute company priorities, and contribute to sustainable growth across retail and distributor partners.


**What can you expect from Champion?**

* **Safety:** a strong commitment to ensure all people are provided with a safe, healthy and respectful environment.
* **Earnings:** $64,000 \- $88,000 USD, annual incentive eligibility, 401k with company matching.
* **Industry Competitive Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision and employee assistance programs to meet your individual or family needs.
* **Continuing Education:** In house \& online learning \& development, as well as an education assistance program.
* **Quality:** a dedication to uphold the highest standards of authenticity, nutritional integrity, and food safety, to earn the trust of pet lovers everywhere.
* **Other Perks:** Free bag of premium pet food each month and more!

We are Champion Petfoods, a crew of pet enthusiasts looking to better the quality of food for our four\-legged friends around the world. If this excites you as much as it does us, then we would love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================


The Group Sales Representative works with brokers, agents and consultants as an Ancillary Group insurance product expert. Will work with new and existing accounts with 50\+ eligible employees.
The **Group Sales Representative** discovers, develops, and maintains benefits brokerage relationships that result in the ongoing sales and retention of Humana's Group benefit products for distribution in a specific region. The **Group Sales Representative** will be held accountable for the achievement of production through tenacious broker development. Brokers should view them as the benefits experts for all products that the executive will sell in the given territory. You will deliver organized, polished presentations of solutions, with benefits tied to the employer's business needs. Will develop and execute a comprehensive strategic plan that results in increased sales and maximized profitability by maintaining and expanding penetration of existing products and cross selling other Humana products.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Develops new business opportunities and implements strategies necessary to attain sales objectives through consultative selling, issue resolution and superior service.
* Manages complex negotiations. Positions products, rate levels, and expanded product portfolios to increase sales and maximize revenue.
* Develop and maintain multiple benefits brokerage and consultant relationships within assigned territory.
* Collaborates with internal partners and/or external constituents to uncover profitable growth and cross\-sell opportunities within new or existing customers and to support post\-sale activities.

* Identify other strategic relationships in the market and develop those circles of influence to drive business to Humana, Inc.

* Occasionally be required to set\-up new cases and participate in enrollment

jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Priority One Management LLC is seeking an Assistant Development Project Manager to support real estate projects through due diligence, entitlements, design, permitting, and construction turnover.

As part of a vertically integrated development and construction company, this position coordinates with consultants, public agencies, and internal team members. The role will work closely with the construction team during design and preconstruction.

This is an opportunity for someone with relevant industry experience to gain broad exposure to the development process and grow into an independent project\-management role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist with project schedules, budgets, documentation, and development tracking.
* Coordinate architects, engineers, planners, surveyors, and other consultants.
* Support entitlement, permitting, utility, and agency\-approval processes.
* Review plans and consultant documents for completeness and coordination.
* Organize meetings, document decisions, and follow up on action items.
* Coordinate design and constructability feedback with the internal construction team.
* Assist with due diligence, feasibility research, and project reporting.
* Maintain organized records of plans, approvals, contracts, and correspondence.

**Qualifications**

* Two to three years of experience in real estate development, planning, architecture, engineering, construction, or a related field.
* Ability to read and review architectural, civil, structural, and consultant plan sets.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, or similar design and plan\-review software.
* Ability to identify basic plan conflicts, missing information, and coordination issues.
* Strong organization, communication, and follow\-through.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred.
* Ability and willingness to travel periodically to **Mammoth Lakes, Ca** based on project needs.
* Ability and willingness to drive to drive to Ventura County and throughout Los Angeles county for in person meetings or work sessions as needed.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

**What We Offer**

* Salary of $60,000–$90,000, depending on experience.
* Performance bonus opportunity.
* Benefits package.
* Housing\-assistance opportunities as part of the compensation package.
* 401(k) retirement plan

* Opportunity for professional growth and increased project responsibility.

jobs.title: Legal Administrative Assistant / Client Services Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**  
We are an established California real estate law firm focused on landlord\-tenant matters. We are seeking an exceptional Legal Administrative Assistant to support a busy team of attorneys and serve as a primary point of contact for our clients.

This is a fast\-paced, client\-facing position requiring exceptional responsiveness, organization, judgment, and the ability to manage numerous matters and competing priorities at the same time. The ideal candidate is highly personable, takes ownership of assignments, communicates exceptionally well, and can effectively keep attorneys, clients, and workflow organized and moving forward in a fast\-paced environment..

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients and provide prompt, professional, and exceptional customer service.
* Manage incoming client requests, including intake of new matters, gathering necessary information and documentation, and routing assignments to the appropriate attorney.
* Manage attorney workflow and assist with prioritizing and tracking a high volume of assignments, deadlines, and client requests.
* Monitor matters from intake through completion and ensure assignments and client requests are timely addressed.
* Maintain frequent communication with clients regarding the status of matters, outstanding information, and next steps.
* Coordinate the completion and delivery of attorney work product and handle matter closeout and related administrative tasks.
* Manage a high volume of emails and telephone calls and ensure communications are promptly routed and responded to.
* Assist attorneys with calendaring, scheduling, correspondence, document preparation, and other administrative needs.
* Maintain organized and accurate electronic client and matter files.
* Prepare, review, and edit routine documents and forms as needed.
* Work closely with attorneys and other staff to identify priorities, anticipate needs, and keep a fast\-moving practice organized. .

**Qualifications:**

* Exceptional customer\-service skills and a professional, positive demeanor.
* Outstanding responsiveness and follow\-through.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritize and manage a large volume of simultaneous assignments without losing track of details.
* Ability to work efficiently and remain composed in a fast\-paced environment with frequent interruptions and changing priorities.
* Strong initiative and ability to anticipate what needs to be done rather than waiting for direction.
* Sound judgment and ability to appropriately prioritize urgent client and attorney requests.
* Comfortable communicating directly with sophisticated business clients and working closely with multiple attorneys.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and Word; experience with ProLaw, Essential Forms, Quickbooks and OneLegal is a plus.
* Prior law firm or professional\-services experience preferred.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $25\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

At **Tillys**, we’re a leading specialty retailer offering casual apparel, footwear, and accessories for young men, women, boys, and girls. Our extensive collection features iconic global brands, emerging labels, and proprietary lines, all rooted in an active and social lifestyle.


Based in sunny Southern California, our **Retail Support Center (RSC**) is the heart of our corporate operations, dedicated to supporting both our retail and online stores. The RSC is where strategy meets execution. From trend forecasting to tech innovation, our teams work together to bring the Tillys experience to life — both in\-store and online.

Events \& Activations

* Manage event calendar planned and executed.
* Assist in communicating and distributing all event collateral with Store Operations
* Maintain a positive and professional relationship with all external and Internal partners.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator – Melanoma and Cutaneous Oncology Program
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Cutaneous Oncology clinical research team supports a diverse portfolio of studies for melanoma and non\-melanoma skin cancers, including squamous cell, basal cell, and Merkel cell carcinomas. The team partners with specialists across Dermatology, Medical Oncology, Surgical Oncology, and Radiation Oncology to provide comprehensive, multidisciplinary care. Our focus includes outpatient, therapeutic cancer clinical trials in phases I–III, including both industry\-sponsored and investigator\-initiated studies. We also manage noninterventional studies aimed at improving early detection, risk assessment, and long\-term survivorship.


The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will independently, or with general direction, execute, manage, and coordinate clinical research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Manager, Principal Investigator (PI), and/or the Associate Director of Clinical Research Programs for the Early Phase program. The CRC will coordinate the administrative, data, and patient scheduling operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols and regulatory policies.


Duties may include, but will not be limited to, supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies; managing and updating databases to ensure data integrity; acting as intermediary between sponsors, research staff, and various UCSF departments; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies;; maintaining relevant regulatory documents in partnership with the Regulatory department; reporting study progress to investigators; participating in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and performing other duties as assigned.  



**Department Overview:**

The UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is one of only two cancer centers in the Bay Area to receive the prestigious designation of “comprehensive” from the National Cancer Institute (NCI).


The HDFCCC integrates the work of researchers and clinicians dedicated to four fundamental pursuits: laboratory research into the causes of cancer progression; clinical research to translate new knowledge into viable treatments; compassionate, state\-of\-the\-art patient care; and population research that can lead to improvements in prevention, early detection, and quality\-of\-life for those living with cancer. The twin pillars of precision medicine and precision population health guide research and treatment at HDFCCC.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Membership Operations Coordinator
**Department:** Membership Growth
**Location:** Oakland, CA
**Reports To:** Director, Membership Operations
**Supervises:** N/A  


**Context:** At the Sierra Club, we believe in the power of interdependence. Together, we remain committed to the fight for a healthy climate built on a foundation of environmental, racial, economic, and gender justice – a future where all people benefit from a healthy, thriving planet and a direct connection to nature. As the climate crisis and deeply entrenched systemic racism all fuel injustice, we will continue to fight for a bold, transformational agenda that recognizes the interconnectedness between our planet, our humanity, and our future. By recognizing that our destinies are tied, we continue to name that all things are fundamentally connected, and the overlap between ecology, race, gender, and representative government will move to either advance our collective humanity or to oppress it. Sierra Club has close to 700 staff across the country and a network of 64 local chapters that are led and fueled by thousands of volunteers. We are also proud to be a unionized employer, with three labor unions representing more than half of our employees.  


**Scope:** Under direct supervision from the Director, Membership Operations, the Membership Operations Coordinator will be responsible for preparing all donations received in the Oakland office for processing and depositing. This is an on\-site position that requires opening and sorting incoming mail in the Oakland office, entering the donor information into the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) database (currently Salesforce), and working with the Sierra Club Finance Department to ensure the donations are deposited. The position is vital to help speed up the process and deposit major gift donations.

### **Job activities include but are not limited to:**

* Opens and sorts incoming mail and prepares for depositing checks by the caging vendor or by the Sierra Club’s Finance Department. Researches incoming check donations in the CRM (Salesforce) database and codes them for processing.


* Images and scans donations to our external vendor for processing. Tracks and edits gifts in the Salesforce database to complete processing.


* Completes data entry of donations for the Sierra Club Foundation. Researches and codes incoming donations for Sierra Club Foundation staff to process in a timely manner. Then enters the donations into the CRM and batches the checks for the Sierra Club Foundation to deposit.


* Works with the caging vendor to identify processing issues and adjust/resolve procedurally.


* Works with the Sierra Club Foundation and the Sierra Club Finance Department to answer any questions on balancing month end reports.


* Works with Chapter staff and volunteers on processing their donations.

Every civilization runs on the same infrastructure: agreements between people who don't fully trust each other. Sumerians pressed them into clay. Romans carved them into stone. We bury them in 80\-page PDFs.

**Job Title:** Regional Operations Coordinator – Commercial Foodservice

**Company:** Plaztigo

**Location:** San Francisco Bay Area / Northern California (Field Sales)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time W\-2 (Exempt Regional Operations Coordinator)

**Compensation:** 100% Top\-Line Commission (Uncapped) \+ IRS Standard Mileage Reimbursement

**Estimated Year 1 Earnings:** $75,000 – $150,000\+ (Based on deal volume \& portfolio growth)

**Benefits:** Health/Medical Insurance NOT Included

**About Plaztigo**

Plaztigo is a modern commercial supply and distribution platform offering **700\+ SKUs**—everything a restaurant, commercial kitchen, bakery, or venue needs under one roof. Beyond our broad product catalog, we feature **custom manufacturing capabilities** for custom\-printed packaging, chopstick sleeves, and tailored branding solutions for commercial operators.

Backed by local Hayward warehouse inventory, custom printing, and a native mobile app/e\-commerce site for frictionless re\-ordering, we give foodservice businesses every reason to partner with us for years.

**The Opportunity**

As a **Regional Operations Coordinator**, you will drive field growth across Northern California by opening new commercial accounts, introducing operators to our custom branding and distribution depth, and onboarding clients onto our digital ordering portal.

**100% Full Compensation \& Earnings Transparency**

This is an **Exempt W\-2 Regional Operations Coordinator position operating on 100% Top\-Line Commission**. There is **no base salary**, but you receive direct payouts on every collected invoice dollar, fully backed by standard legal expense reimbursements.

* **Upfront Digital Onboarding Bonus:** **3\.5% on total top\-line invoice revenue** for the first paid order when you close and onboard a client onto our web/app portal.
* **12\-Month Recurring Residuals:** **2\.5% monthly residual** on all recurring re\-orders placed during the account’s first 12 months.
* **Full Expense Reimbursement:** Paid at the standard **IRS Business Mileage Rate** for all field travel between client sites (covering fuel, wear\-and\-tear, and vehicle operation).
* **Sample \& Sales Backing:** 100% company\-funded physical product sample kits, custom\-print proofs, and digital collateral.
* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance are not provided for this role.

**Uncapped Account Earnings: Real Examples**

There is **no ceiling on account size or payout**. Closing larger accounts directly multiplies your recurring monthly checks:

* **Typical Retailer ($4,000/mo volume):** Pays **$140 upfront** \+ **$100/mo** recurring residual ($1,200/yr).
* **5\-Location Local Chain ($25,000/mo volume):** Pays **$875 upfront** \+ **$625/mo** recurring residual ($7,500/yr).
* **Regional Group / Sub\-Distributor ($100,000/mo volume):** Pays **$3,500 upfront** \+ **$2,500/mo** recurring residual ($30,000/yr) from a **single account**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Field Prospecting:** Conduct face\-to\-face sales calls with restaurant owners, multi\-unit operators, commercial kitchens, and venue buyers across Northern California.
* **Digital Onboarding:** Guide clients through setup on our mobile app or web portal for automated re\-ordering.
* **Account Portfolio Management:** Monitor re\-order patterns ($3k–$5k\+/mo target volume per retail account) and follow up proactively to maintain monthly residual income.
* **Active Field Presence:** Spend more than 50% of working time active in the field meeting with buyers.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

* **2\+ Years B2B Sales Experience:** Proven track record in commercial packaging, foodservice distribution, beverage/food supply, or jan/san supplies.
* **Active Operator Network:** Pre\-existing, active relationships with Bay Area restaurant owners, hospitality groups, or commercial food buyers is required.
* **Self\-Driven Portfolio Builder:** Motivated by building a long\-term, high\-earning recurring commission portfolio.
* **Field Mobility:** Valid CA driver’s license, reliable personal vehicle, and active auto insurance.

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Alex**
--------------


Alex is the AI recruiter for hiring great people.


Alex interviews, screens, and schedules every candidate – over voice, video, and text – so talent teams hire more great people, faster, without adding TA headcount. The recruiter stays in control: every shortlist is approved by a human, and every relationship and offer is owned by the customer's team.


We're past 1M\+ interviews, integrate with 33\+ ATS platforms, and 96% of candidates prefer interviewing with Alex. We're revenue\-generating, well\-funded, backed by premier investors, and are focused on enterprise customers: selling to VPs of Talent Acquisition, CHROs, and CFOs at large employers who are rethinking how hiring gets done at scale.

**About the Role**
------------------


Every Alex account is run by a pair. A Forward\-Deployed Engineer owns the technical deployment — the ATS integration, the workflows, the support queue. You own the relationship and the revenue. You're joining the AM team early, and your input will shape the function. This role is based in office in San Francisco.


You'll carry a book of accounts: retaining and growing revenue, deepening the relationship, and finding the strategic expansion paths.

* **Own NRR for your book** — renewals end to end, plus the upsells and expansions that grow an account past its initial booking.
* **Multi\-thread the relationship** — exec sponsors, champions, and the recruiters using Alex daily, so a single departure doesn't take the account with it.
* **Drive adoption** — onboard users, run trainings, and watch usage closely enough to spot which teams need a nudge before it surfaces in a renewal.
* **Build the business case, inside and out** — arm your champion to sell Alex to their own leadership, then turn those wins into case studies that help close the next deal.
* **Lead QBRs with business stakeholders**, using usage data and our roadmap to open expansion paths. Set success criteria at kickoff so renewals confirm next steps rather than force them.
* **Work the pair with engineering** — route technical asks to your FDE rather than absorbing them, and pass expansion signals back the other way.

**About You**
-------------

* 5\+ years in Account Management, Customer Success with a revenue number, or an AE carrying a renewal and expansion book, at a SaaS company. You can name the target you carried and how you hit it.
* You've owned renewals end to end — timeline, pricing, negotiation, close — and you're comfortable asking for money.
* You've gotten a customer's team to change how they work, not just gotten a contract signed.
* Credible with executives and with recruiters on the same day.
* Technically fluent, not technically hands\-on: you can hold a real conversation about an ATS integration and know when to bring in your FDE.
* A data\-driven storyteller: you act on usage metrics before a renewal is at risk, and turn a customer win into collateral that helps win the next one.
* A commercially confident builder: you'd rather have the pricing conversation early than let it sit, and you’re excited to build playbooks for this function at you go.
* Bonus: experience at a high\-growth startup.


This might not be the role for you if you prefer a support role without a number attached, or you don't want to work in person. We're in office in SF 5 days a week.

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

* Shape the foundation of our Account Management org, with an engineer paired with you on every account you run.
* Competitive compensation, equity, and growth potential.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited PTO, company\-paid team lunches, a beautiful office in SF, and great company events.


If you've gotten this far and our culture resonates with you, we want you to apply. Your first conversation will be with Alex, our AI recruiter.


Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K
