jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
===================

  

**Date:** Aug 24, 2026


**Location:** San Jose, California, United States


**Company:** Super Micro Computer


**Job Req ID: 29999**
---------------------


**About Supermicro:**
---------------------


Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.  

  



**Job Summary:**
----------------


Supermicro Computer is looking for an Account Manager who has experience with selling technical solutions and developing business. The ideal candidate must also have a proven track record in winning enterprise level relationships and consistently achieving and exceeding assigned sales quotas.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------


* Manage products through their entire lifecycle until product EOL


* Develop strategic sales goals with exceptional execution to meet the sales target


* Qualify leads and creating target lists of enterprise or data center accounts


* Seek potential customers (e.g., Corporate Customers, Value\-Added Resellers, OEMs) through cold calling and follow\-up customer visits


* Participate in marketing activities such as trade shows to generate leads


* Ability to strategically positioned Supermicro’s products and services in the market


* Develop customer relationships and maintain/manage accounts, expand existing client accounts for retention and potential growth


* Work with cross functional teams to draft and negotiate various types of contracts


* Manage day\-to\-day sales operations


* Negotiate sales pricing, monitoring orders, facilitating credit issues and negotiating sales returns


**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Bachelor degree in business, engineering or similar fields preferred

• 1 year of hands\-on experience with selling computer hardware solutions to data center or enterprise accounts (prior software or telecom sales will be considered) preferred
  

• Successful track record with credible cold calling and follow\-up with key decision makers
  

• Ability to thrive both independently and in a team environment
  

• Demonstrated ability in the following areas: pre\-call planning, opportunity qualification and objection handling, call structure and control, time and territory management
  

• Strong persuasive and negotiating skills; Ability to polished words in verbal, written, and presentation
  

• Extremely proactive, highly organized, with proven ability to manage multiple tasks
  

• Exceptional management skill in time and territory
**Salary Range**
----------------


$72,500 \- $104,000


The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.


**EEO Statement**
-----------------


Supermicro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Construction Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our dynamic team as a Construction Sales Representative and become a vital driver of growth in the construction industry! In this energetic role, you will leverage your management expertise, sales acumen, and technical knowledge to develop new business opportunities, manage client accounts, and build lasting relationships with customers. Your enthusiasm for business development and customer service will help you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where your efforts directly impact company success. This position offers an exciting chance to work with cutting\-edge technology sales, territory management, and innovative marketing strategies to achieve ambitious sales targets.

**Responsibilities**

* Identify and pursue new B2B sales opportunities within designated territories through cold calling, prospecting, and lead generation activities
* Manage existing client accounts by providing exceptional customer service, understanding client needs, and upselling relevant products or services
* Develop strategic sales plans to expand market share and meet or exceed sales targets in the construction sector
* Conduct product presentations and technical demonstrations tailored to client requirements, emphasizing benefits and solutions
* Negotiate contracts and close deals efficiently while maintaining strong customer relationships and ensuring customer satisfaction
* Utilize CRM software and sales management systems to track leads, manage pipeline activities, and generate accurate sales reports
* Collaborate with marketing teams to develop territory\-specific campaigns that enhance brand visibility and attract new clients

**Experience**

* Proven success in outside sales or inside sales roles within the construction, technology, or B2B sales sectors
* Demonstrated experience with CRM systems such as Salesforce or similar platforms for managing customer relationships and sales processes
* Strong management skills with the ability to lead negotiations, close deals, and develop long\-term client partnerships
* Technical sales experience involving construction products or related industries is highly preferred
* Excellent communication skills for effective client interaction, negotiation, and presentation delivery
* Ability to work remotely within a dynamic environment while maintaining high levels of motivation and organization
* Familiarity with territory management, lead generation techniques, and achieving aggressive sales targets

Embark on a rewarding career where your proactive approach and technical expertise will make a tangible difference. We’re looking for motivated professionals eager to grow their skills in a vibrant industry—if you’re passionate about building relationships and driving results in construction sales, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $250,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Milpitas, Santa Clara County, CA
**Requisition ID** 2026\-125711 **Category** Retail Branch **Position type** Regular **Pay range** USD $29\.38 \- $48\.41 / Hour **Application deadline** 2026\-09\-01
  
**Your opportunity**
--------------------

  

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make a meaningful impact—for clients and for your career.
As a Client Relationship Specialist (CRS), you play a vital role in delivering a personalized,
  

high\-quality client experience while supporting the operational success of the branch. This
  

role is an excellent entry point into the financial services industry, offering hands\-on client
  

interaction, exposure to wealth management services, and a clear path for growth.
In this role, you will ensure clients feel heard, supported, and confident in their relationship
  

with Schwab. Development is central to this role, and Schwab provides the resources,
  

coaching, and learning opportunities to help you build skills and expand your career—  

including support for required licensing aligned to your goals.* Deliver a welcoming, inclusive client experience by understanding needs and
  

resolving requests with accuracy and care.
* Support daily branch operations, including account servicing, documentation, and
  

follow\-up with strong attention to detail.
* Communicate effectively with clients and colleagues, adapting to different styles and
  

needs.
* Use active listening to understand priorities and escalate issues when needed.
* Manage multiple tasks and priorities to meet deadlines and maintain quality.
* Partner with team members to drive client engagement and operational excellence.
* Build trust and long\-term relationships through professionalism, reliability, and a
  

client\-first mindset.

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Associate (College Grad 2027)
jobs.description:
**About Solace**
----------------


Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.


We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission\-driven, and growing quickly.


Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

***Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement*** ***here******.***

**About the Role**
------------------


As an Influencer Marketing Associate at Solace, you'll help the team find great creators, build strong working relationships, and keep influencer campaigns moving from outreach through launch and reporting. This is an early\-career role for a recent graduate who understands internet culture, communicates well, and is excited to learn how creator marketing works behind the scenes.


You don't need years of agency or talent\-management experience. You do need strong judgment, excellent follow\-through, and genuine curiosity about creators and the communities they build. You'll learn from experienced marketers while taking on meaningful execution work from day one.


Because Solace works in healthcare, you'll also learn how to create compelling marketing while handling patient stories, claims, disclosures, approvals, and sensitive information with care.

**This is a hybrid in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Creator Research \& Outreach**

* Research creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, and other emerging channels based on audience fit, content quality, credibility, and campaign goals.
* Build creator shortlists and organize relevant information such as audience, content style, contact details, prior partnerships, and performance signals.
* Support creator outreach using approved messaging and keep responses, follow\-ups, and next steps organized.
* Stay close to creator culture and surface new voices, formats, trends, and conversations that may be relevant to Solace.

### **Campaign Coordination**

* Help turn campaign strategy into clear creator briefs, timelines, deliverable lists, and launch trackers.
* Coordinate scheduling, content submissions, review rounds, approvals, and go\-live dates across multiple creators.
* Maintain accurate records for contracts, usage rights, deliverables, payment status, contact history, and campaign notes.
* Perform an initial check of submitted content against the brief, required disclosures, format requirements, and approved messaging before escalating for final review.
* Flag missed deadlines, unclear deliverables, or other campaign risks early and help the team resolve them.

### **Performance \& Team Support**

* Pull basic campaign metrics and organize results so the team can see which creators, messages, and formats are performing.
* Help prepare campaign recaps and document learnings for future creator selection and briefs.
* Keep the influencer roster, campaign trackers, folders, and Notion pages clean and current.
* Coordinate with brand, creative, performance, partnerships, legal, and compliance teams when campaigns require additional review or support.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 0–2 years of relevant experience. Internships, student organizations, your own content, freelance projects, campus ambassador work, talent or entertainment experience, and side projects all count.
* You are genuinely interested in creators, social platforms, digital culture, and why certain content earns trust and attention.
* You are highly organized and can keep many small details moving without losing track of deadlines.
* You write clear, warm, professional messages and understand that every creator interaction represents the Solace brand.
* You have good judgment and know when to move something forward independently versus when to ask for help.
* You take feedback well, make changes quickly, and do not get defensive when a first draft needs work.
* You are comfortable working quickly while being thoughtful about healthcare claims, patient privacy, and sensitive stories.
* You are resourceful. If you do not know how to find a creator, organize a process, or solve a small operational problem, your instinct is to figure it out.

**What You Bring to the Table**
-------------------------------

* A strong point of view on social media and creators, even if your experience comes from school, internships, personal projects, or your own online presence.
* Experience with Notion, Google Sheets, Airtable, creator\-management tools, or similar systems is helpful but not required.
* Any experience with creator outreach, campus ambassadors, social content, talent coordination, PR, events, or community management.
* Interest in healthcare, wellness, consumer technology, or mission\-driven storytelling.

*Applicants must be based in the United States.*

**Up for the Challenge?**

We look forward to meeting you.

**Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory:** Solace Health will **NEVER** request bank details or offer employment without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com. Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

jobs.title: Manager, Digital Marketing
jobs.description:
**About Karius**



Karius is a life science, venture\-backed clinical metagenomics company, focused on elevating patient care through microbial insights. We are committed to advancing diagnostic science and technology to optimize the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases. Through the use of genomics and AI, we are driven to improve the diagnostic landscape for infectious diseases. Karius delivers unprecedented diagnostic insight detecting microbial cell\-free DNA circulating in the body to assist physicians to make rapid treatment decisions.

  


**Position Summary**



We are seeking a talented Digital Marketing Manager to help accelerate awareness and adoption of Karius’s metagenomic testing portfolio across the hospital and outpatient settings. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, executing and optimizing comprehensive digital channel growth strategies in partnership with internal teams and agency partners. You will be an integral part of advancing our commercial capabilities to reach new markets and audiences. This role requires experience managing digital marketing channels in the healthcare setting, strong communication and organizational skills, a curious mindset, and a passion for helping patients and clinicians.

  


**Why Should You Join Us?**



Karius aims to conquer infectious diseases through innovations around genomic sequencing and machine learning. The company’s platform is already delivering unprecedented insights into the microbial landscape, providing clinicians with a comprehensive test capable of identifying more than a thousand pathogens directly from blood, and helping industry accelerate the development of therapeutic solutions. The products Karius offers today are some of the most advanced solutions available to physicians who aim to deliver better care to many otherwise ineffectively treated patients. Our tests are the result of some incredible work done by our scientists, statisticians, engineers, and physicians, all driven by the same mission. You, as part of the Karius team, will be able to see how directly your work has a life\-changing impact on people, and at scale.

  


**Reports to:** Sr. Director, Marketing

  


**Location:** Redwood City, CA (Hybrid) or Remote (USA)

  


**Primary Responsibilities**


* Partner across internal teams and agency partners to design and execute digital channel campaigns that are aligned to Karius’s commercial strategy and segment objectives.
* Support the development, implementation and optimization of a direct\-to\-provider and direct\-to\-patient channel strategy that empowers immunocompromised patients to access metagenomic testing at the moment it's needed.
* Drive digital marketing programs that demonstrate measurable commercial impact, including generating qualified leads, influencing customer acquisition pipeline, and delivering revenue. Establish and validate proof of concept for new digital strategies through attributable revenue to support business cases for scaling.
* Develop content in partnership with the Director, Sales Enablement and Director, Branding \& Events that is aligned with multi\-channel campaign objectives
* Build out measurement frameworks and KPIs in collaboration with Commercial Operations to assess the impact of integrated channel strategy and enable data\-driven optimization.
* Provide input on how the digital content and marketing strategy should evolve in response to changing customer behavior, market trends, search evolution and AI modalities.

**What’s Fun About the Job?**



Karius is operating at the edge of what is now known to be possible in diagnostics. With that, comes a wave of new and incredible challenges and opportunities. To deliver on that value, you will be tapping into some of the most advanced technologies, architecting and innovating where the current solutions simply don't suffice. You will get to see how much your work really matters.

  

**Travel:** Travel required (up to 10%).

  


**Physical Requirements**



Subject to extended periods of sitting and/or standing, vision to monitor and moderate noise levels. Work is generally performed in an office, lab or clinical environment.

  


**Position Requirements**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales or equivalent. Advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in Marketing, Advertising, Analytics, Sales and/or Strategy Consulting, preferably within life sciences or healthcare.
* Demonstrated track record of translating digital marketing programs into measurable commercial outcomes, including qualified leads, pipeline optimization, and attributable or influenced revenue.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect channel performance and customer behavior to actionable commercial recommendations.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations for diverse and senior stakeholders.
* Experience translating complex scientific and medical topics into engaging digital content for healthcare providers and patient audiences.
* Strong expertise in digital marketing, marketing analytics, and content management systems.

  




**Personal Qualifications**


* Passionate, purpose\-driven, and excited about Karius’ mission.
* Mastered your craft, eager to learn and grow and desire to share knowledge.
* Detail oriented with exceptional organizational and time management skills.
* Endless curiosity and a need to dive deeper for understanding.
* Excellence at communication and collaboration within a cross\-functional team; ability to summarize data and present information to stakeholders.
* Self\-starting mentality and ability to drive results.

jobs.description:
**About Trustero**


Trustero is the AI\-driven advisor for Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Powered by a patented multi\-agent AI architecture and our proprietary Trust Graph, Trustero automates evidence collection, control monitoring, gap analysis, and security questionnaire response — helping security, compliance, and risk teams get and stay audit\-ready across frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST, PCI DSS, SOX, and more. Enterprise, mid\-market, and MSSPs use Trustero to turn GRC from a manual, reactive burden into a continuous, AI\-powered program. Learn more at trustero.com.

**The Role**


Trustero is hiring a Business Development Representative (BDR) to fuel our top\-of\-funnel pipeline growth across the US and EU territories. This is a pure hunter role — you will be responsible for sourcing, mapping, and opening doors at target enterprise and mid\-market accounts. You’ll engage security, compliance, risk, and IT leaders (CISOs, Heads of GRC, VPs of Security) who are actively seeking ways to modernize and scale their GRC programs through AI.


This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role for an ambitious pipeline builder who thrives on multi\-channel cold outreach, strategic account mapping, and qualifying high\-value sales opportunities in a fast\-moving market.

**What You'll Do**

* Prospect and generate qualified sales meetings/opportunities through outbound multi\-channel outreach (cold email, cold calling, LinkedIn, and video touchpoints).
* Own the initial stages of the sales funnel, mapping target accounts and identifying key decision\-makers across security, compliance, risk, and IT departments.
* Conduct initial discovery conversations to evaluate fit, pain points, and buyer readiness, effectively qualifying leads before handing them off to Account Executives.
* Build a solid baseline understanding of buyers' compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, NIST, PCI DSS, SOX, GDPR) to articulate how Trustero’s multi\-agent AI delivers ROI and continuous audit readiness.
* Partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to execute strategic account\-based marketing (ABM) strategies and targeted territory campaigns.
* Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene, tracking touchpoints, account intelligence, and opportunity handoffs in Salesforce/HubSpot.
* Represent Trustero at virtual events and industry webinars, following up rapidly on leads to convert interest into qualified meetings.
* Consistently meet or exceed monthly/quarterly targets for qualified meetings set and opportunities generated.

 **What We're Looking For**

* Proven hunter mentality: a track record of high\-volume, quality outbound prospecting and self\-sourcing meetings in B2B tech/SaaS.
* 1–3 years of outbound business development or sales development experience (SDR/BDR), ideally within cybersecurity, GRC/compliance, or enterprise software.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate complex enterprise org charts and comfortably initiate conversations with executive buyers (CISO, CCO, VP/Head of GRC).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to deliver concise, compelling value propositions.
* Familiarity with modern sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo) and CRM platforms.
* Relentless curiosity, high emotional intelligence, and resilience in handling objections and building dynamic cold touchpoints.
* Fluency in English required; additional European languages (e.g., German, French) are a major plus for EU territory coverage.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience prospecting for AI\-native, cybersecurity, or SaaS compliance platforms.
* Basic understanding of GRC frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.) or security workflows.
* Experience running account\-based outbound motions against Fortune 2000 or mid\-market accounts.

We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full\-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  

  

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.  

  

**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium\-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**  

  

**A Brief Overview**  

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at TriNet you will serve as the face of a well established, reputable company that empowers the small business community to focus on what matters most – growing their business. This individual is often the first line of communication between TriNet and prospective clients as the person responsible for identifying, contacting and qualifying opportunities for the sales organization to generate new business. This role, coupled with TriNet emphasis on continuous learning and defined career paths, will lay the foundation for a successful sales career. If you are somebody looking to accelerate your sales development career with a high growth, stable company and rewarding mission, then come join us!  

  

**What you will do**


* Secure meetings with the right people, at the right place, at the right time to create high quality sales opportunities for the field sales team.
* The focus each day for our SDRs is getting connected with decision makers, extending the conversation, and securing meetings for our field sales team.
* Use internal sales tools and resources to execute a high touch sales cadence on prospects.
* Make around 80 cold calls a day to prospects to gauge interest.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
All Property Tech is a growing construction and property restoration company serving residential and commercial property owners throughout the Bay Area. We specialize in helping property owners, property managers, contractors, and insurance\-related partners navigate property damage and construction projects from the initial assessment through completion.

Our services include **water damage restoration, mold remediation, fire and smoke restoration, reconstruction, remodeling, property repairs, ADU construction, tenant improvements and other property improvement services.**

We are looking for a motivated, personable, and results\-driven **Business Development Representative** to help expand our network of referral partners and generate new business throughout the Bay Area.

Job Overview

The Business Development Representative will be responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with the people and businesses that can refer projects to All Property Tech.

This is a **relationship\-driven, field\-based sales position**. You will spend significant time meeting with potential referral partners, visiting businesses and job sites, attending networking events, following up with existing contacts, and identifying opportunities where All Property Tech can provide value.

The ideal candidate is someone who is comfortable walking into a business, introducing themselves, building relationships, and becoming the person people think of when they need a reliable construction or restoration company.

You do not need to be a construction expert on day one. We will provide training on our services and processes. What matters most is your ability to **build relationships, communicate professionally, follow up consistently, and generate business.**

What You'll Do

* Develop and maintain relationships with property managers, real estate professionals, insurance professionals, contractors, commercial property owners, HOAs, apartment communities, and other potential referral partners.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities throughout the Bay Area.
* Make in\-person visits to potential referral partners and establish All Property Tech as a trusted resource.
* Build and maintain a strong referral network.
* Follow up with existing contacts to generate repeat and referral business.
* Schedule meetings, property visits, inspections, and qualified opportunities for the appropriate All Property Tech team members.
* Educate potential partners about All Property Tech's restoration, construction, remodeling, and property repair services.
* Represent All Property Tech at networking events, trade shows, community events, and industry functions.
* Develop relationships with insurance agents, adjusters, property managers, real estate agents, contractors, and other professionals who regularly encounter property damage or construction needs.
* Identify opportunities involving water damage, mold, fire damage, reconstruction, remodeling, ADUs, and general property repairs.
* Maintain accurate records of contacts, meetings, referrals, opportunities, and follow\-ups.
* Track business development activities and report results to management.
* Work closely with estimators, project managers, and management to ensure qualified opportunities are properly communicated and handed off.
* Monitor market conditions, competitors, and opportunities for growth.
* Help develop creative strategies for increasing All Property Tech's visibility and referral network.
* Maintain a professional and positive representation of the All Property Tech brand.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **personable, confident, organized, persistent, and comfortable building relationships.**

The right person doesn't need to be a pushy salesperson. Instead, they should be someone who enjoys meeting people, understands the importance of follow\-up, and can turn professional relationships into long\-term business opportunities.

Required Qualifications

* 1\+ year of experience in business development, sales, account management, customer service, construction, restoration, real estate, property management, or a related field preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable meeting new people and developing professional relationships.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Professional appearance and communication style.
* Comfortable making phone calls, sending emails, and conducting in\-person business visits.
* Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Ability to travel throughout the Bay Area as needed.
* Comfortable using email, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and customer tracking systems.

Preferred Qualifications

* Existing relationships within the construction, restoration, insurance, real estate, or property management industries.
* Previous business development or outside sales experience.
* Experience working with property managers, apartment communities, HOAs, real estate professionals, contractors, or insurance professionals.
* Knowledge of residential or commercial construction.
* Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
* Experience in the restoration or construction industry is a plus.

Who You'll Build Relationships With

A major part of this position will be developing referral relationships with:

* Property Management Companies
* Property Managers
* Real Estate Agents \& Brokers
* Insurance Agents
* Insurance Adjusters
* General Contractors
* Plumbers
* HVAC Companies
* Roofing Contractors
* Apartment Communities
* HOAs
* Commercial Property Owners
* Real Estate Investors
* Facility Managers
* Other Local Businesses \& Professionals

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position is measured by the strength of your relationships and the business you generate.

Key performance indicators may include:

* New referral partners established
* Qualified leads generated
* Referral opportunities

* Present to the Project Review Committee
* Work with Loans and Grants, and Contract Admin to ensure timely reimbursement of awards

* Represent Global NY at public events and initiate events in your territory that are export\-focused; speak at export events per year and hold Global NY events throughout your territory.

* When requested by the foreign contract offices, contacts representatives of local firms, banks, trade associations, governments, etc., to develop/provide information when such contact is deemed relevant to a specific potential trade project.
* Travel is Required.

Minimum Qualifications MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
  

This title is part of the New York Hiring for Emergency Limited Placement Statewide Program (NY HELPS).
  

  

For the duration of the NY HELPS Program, this title may be filled via a non\-competitive appointment, which means no examination is required. However, all candidates must meet the minimum qualifications of the title for which they apply.
  

  

At a future date, it is expected employees hired under NY HELPS will have their non\-competitive employment status converted to competitive status, without having to compete in an examination. Employees will then be afforded with all the same rights and privileges of competitive class employees of New York State. While serving permanently in a NY HELPS title, employees may take part in any promotion examination for which they are qualified.

A bachelor's and three years of experience applying business knowledge, training and experience to provide a wide range of professional and management level economic development services for the promotion of business, tourism and international trade in New York State, providing technical advice and problem\-solving assistance to economic development organizations and businesses by conducting business\-to\-business marketing programs, and promoting, publicizing, and developing strategic plans and initiatives related to business and economic development services.

A Juris Doctor, master's or higher degree in a related field can substitute for one year of specialized experience.
  

  

List Eligibility: Open to those reachable on the Economic Development Program Specialist 2 eligible list.
  

  

Transfer Eligibility: Candidates must have one year of permanent competitive service in a title eligible for transfer via Section 70\.1 of the Civil Service Law. Information regarding transfer eligibility may be available on the Civil Service Career Mobility Office website at https://careermobilityoffice.cs.ny.gov/cmo/.
  

  

(Important Note: Per Civil Service Law, an employee cannot have two, consecutive upward 70\.1 or 52\.6 transfers without an intervening eligible list appointment if such transfers would exceed two salary grades.)
  

  

Reinstatement Eligibility: Previously held the title on a permanent competitive basis or held a title as indicated under the transfer eligible section on a permanent competitive basis.

jobs.title: Foster Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Foster Program Coordinator**

**Schedule:**
The working schedule for this position is Tuesday \- Saturday, 9:30AM \- 6PM with Sunday and Monday day off. **Who We Are**
ACC is one of the nation’s largest open\-admission animal shelters, whose mission is to End Animal Homelessness in NYC. We touch the lives of nearly 20,000 animals each year. ACC is more than an animal shelter; we are a resource to the community, always seeking ways to keep the human\-animal bond intact. With a 90% placement rate, our progressive, life\-saving initiatives contribute to the successful placement of our animals.  

We strive to find loving homes for homeless and abandoned cats, dogs, guinea pigs and rabbits, both by adopting animals directly to the public and by partnering with more than 200 dedicated animal placement organizations (our New Hope partners). We also help keep NYC communities safe and rescue animals in need, responding to emergencies that involve animals as well as keeping our doors open 24/7 for people and animals in need. **Summary**  

The Foster Program Coordinator is responsible for maintaining the day\-to\-day operations of the foster program. As a Foster Program Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating the movement of animals in and out of foster homes, providing support to a network of over 800 foster parents, and help facilitate the adoption process for every animal in foster care.

**Required Qualifications**:* High School Diploma or GED required.
* The ideal candidate should have a minimum of two\-years work experience in a client facing position.
* Strong computer literacy required.
* Able to excel in a fast\-paced, often high\-stress, ever\-changing environment.
* Treat animals and people with respect and employ humane handling techniques whenever possible.
* Must be able to lift and move up to 50 lbs.

 **Benefits**
ACC values work/life balance and offers a generous paid\-time\-off (PTO) package that includes vacation time, birthdays off, personal days and sick pay. We also value physical and mental health by offering a great open access Cigna medical, dental and vision insurance at a low premium to our employees as well as 401K and Pension, Life Insurance. We also have on\-the\-job training for 2\-4 weeks, periodic all staff trainings to include safety, DEI, cross training, and other growth opportunities.


Because ACC is a nonprofit, employees may be eligible for loan forgiveness, cancellation, and/or consolidation under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program (PSLF). Created under the College Cost Reduction and Access Act of 2007, PSLF allows borrowers who work full time for nonprofits and government agencies to have their outstanding debt forgiven tax\-free on Federal Direct Loans, after making 120 qualifying monthly payments under a qualifying repayment plan.


Please use this link for more details on our benefits package. **Essential Job Functions**:* Provide support to foster volunteers to ensure all their needs are being met. This includes answering questions, providing support for behavioral issues, following up with medical concerns, and handling other issues that may arise.
* Coordinate transportation of foster animals to foster volunteers, between care centers, and to adoption events.
* Coordinate with Veterinary Services to ensure foster animals leave the care center with appropriate vaccines and treatment plans, schedule follow\-up vet appointments, and assist with handling animals when appropriate.

 **Other Responsibilities**:* Assist in identifying appropriate foster animals for off\-site adoption, outreach, and media opportunities.
* Coordinate logistics for foster animals attending events including scheduling behavior assessments, medical, and transport.
* Assist Foster Supervisor with management of foster volunteer database.
* Secure appropriate photographs of animals for foster and events.
* Recruit new foster volunteers through orientations, interviews, and training.
* Lead Open Foster Hours, identify appropriate foster animals to new fosters.
* Fear Free certification within 30 days of hire.
* Complete other duties as assigned by supervisor.

 **Preferred Qualifications**:* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Prior experience with Microsoft Office Suite preferred.
* Prior experience with animals (dogs/cats/rabbits), either paid or volunteer, is strongly preferred but not required.
* Bi\-lingual (Spanish) preferred but not required.
* Customer\-driven and focused on providing a positive, upbeat, experience for all clients.
* High attention to detail, strong work ethic, and the ability to thrive while working in busy environment.
* Work well independently but also function seamlessly as a member of a team.

 **Work Environment:**
At ACC it's all hands\-on deck. We work together as a team, which means you may be asked to help with tasks that involve working outside in all sorts of weather. As a busy animal shelter in one of the biggest cities in the world it can get noisy inside. Employees should have the ability to remain calm yet professional in stressful situations involving animals and/or members of the public. ACC houses hundreds of animals in its facilities at any given time and with that comes fur, odors and other airborne particles in abundance.  

ACC offers many low\-cost services to pets and people in need. This includes compassionate end\-of\-life services for people who cannot afford to go to a private veterinary office but still want to provide a professional and peaceful transition for their beloved pet.  

Training will take place at our Manhattan Centers. Employees will report there until the Bronx location is fully operational. **Reports To:** Foster Supervisor **Overtime:** This is a non\-union position and is eligible for overtime.

**Company Description**  

JUNGLE Communications, Inc. is a full\-service, boutique marketing and advertising agency based in Jersey City committed to growing purpose\-driven brands.


We provide lean and results\-driven advertising, marketing, video production and brand growth solutions for our client portfolio of professional service providers (doctors, lawyers, dentists, financial institutions, educational clients, etc.), national Christian organizations, and local not\-for\-profit groups.


Our commitment to understanding our clients’ passions, experiences, and business models, along with our guerrilla marketing DNA, drive the competitive strategies we establish to help them exceed their dreams and goals.


Our search for talent is simple \- recruit awesome people who do great work and give them the ability to learn, lead and grow in our creative and caring environment.

We’re looking for a Communications \& Marketing Coordinator who is a strong writer, naturally curious, organized, and excited to get involved in different areas of marketing.


In this role, you’ll work closely with our CEO and marketing team to support client projects, campaigns, research, content, advertising, events, and agency initiatives.


This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build a well\-rounded marketing skill set rather than specialize in just one area.

**What You'll Do**

**Your day\-to\-day may include:**

* Researching clients, industries, audiences, competitors, and market trends
* Helping develop marketing and advertising campaigns
* Writing and editing copy for websites, social media, blogs, emails, advertisements, and other materials
* Supporting digital and traditional advertising campaigns
* Monitoring campaign performance and helping track results
* Assisting with social media and digital marketing initiatives
* Supporting client events, agency events, and marketing activations
* Assisting with video and creative production
* Helping develop presentations, proposals, and marketing materials
* Communicating with clients, vendors, media outlets, and partners
* Staying up to date on marketing, media, technology, and industry trends

 **Qualifications** **What We're Looking For**

**You may be a great fit if you:**

* Enjoy writing and have strong communication skills
* Have an interest in marketing, advertising, communications, media, or creative work
* Are organized and comfortable managing multiple projects
* Pay attention to details but can also see the bigger picture
* Are comfortable researching and learning new topics quickly
* Take initiative and don't always need to be told what to do next
* Enjoy working with different types of people and personalities
* Are comfortable in a fast\-paced, creative environment
* Can turn ideas into action and aren't afraid to ask questions

A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Media, or a related field is preferred but not required.

Experience working with faith\-based, nonprofit, healthcare, professional services, or other purpose\-driven organizations is a plus—but not required.

Vacation and holiday pay after 3 months

CAMP is a Family Experience Company launched in 2018, known for our one\-of\-a\-kind shop/play hybrid experience at physical locations across the country. Each CAMP store features rotating themed experiences where families come to play, explore, and create unforgettable memories together. We believe that play connects us all, and at CAMP, play is bigger, bubblier, funnier, fuzzier, slimier, and sillier than anywhere else.


**WHAT IS THE ROLE?**



We are looking for a full\-time Production Coordinator to support day\-to\-day project execution across CAMP's Production department. In this hybrid role, you will work remotely day\-to\-day while maintaining full responsibility for on\-site execution during critical project phases. You are the meticulous organizer who keeps project schedules, file systems, and vendor inventories up to date, ensuring no detail falls through the cracks—whether virtually or on the ground at load\-ins, walk\-throughs, and live activations.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO/BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**


**Support Projects \& Vendor Logistics**


* **Project Tracking:** Maintain up\-to\-date project timelines, schedules, and task management tools across active initiatives.
* **File \& Information Management:** Organize production files, assets, and project data as updates arrive.
* **Vendor Operations:** Field initial vendor outreach, conduct vetting, and coordinate ongoing communications with external partners.
* **Sourcing \& Inventory:** Source props, materials, and small\-scale vendors; source post\-launch prop replacements and maintain accurate store ordering lists.
* **Budget Support:** Track project expenditures real\-time to maintain budget accuracy, assisting with financial reconciliations upon project wrap.
* **Client \& Team Syncs:** Draft updates and support client\-facing and internal progress meetings.


**Be the Boots\-on\-the\-Ground Lead**


* **On\-Site Execution:** Serve as the primary on\-site production contact for load\-in/out, walkthroughs, launches, and live events (requires occasional evening and weekend shifts).
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Align production schedules across store teams, cross\-functional partners, and outside vendors to eliminate schedule gaps.
* **Site Quality Assurance:** Perform regular check\-ins with store and show teams to maintain setup quality and address operational needs.
* **Training \& Compliance Documentation:** Create and track execution resources, including weekly store checklists, bi\-weekly carpenter logs, and compliance guides.
* **Brand \& IP Integrity:** Ensure all physical deliverables align with CAMP brand standards and partner/licensor IP guidelines in coordination with the Director of Production.
* **Set Maintenance:** Assist with set servicing and live show maintenance planning.


**Key Performance Indicators**


* **Schedule Completeness:** Comprehensive coverage of store and show operations with zero missed details.
* **Data Currency:** Real\-time accuracy of timelines, file structures, and purchasing lists without post\-project fixes.
* **Field Satisfaction:** High responsiveness and positive feedback from store staff and on\-site teams.
* **Brand \& Compliance Accuracy:** Flawless alignment with brand/IP guidelines during site load\-in and launch.
* **Budget Precision:** Ongoing budget tracking with clean, prompt post\-project wraps.


**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO CAMP**


**Basic Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of project or production experience within experiential marketing, events, live entertainment, or brand activations.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and multi\-tasking skills across simultaneous workflows.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing tight deadline pressures.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* High attention to detail across both large\-scale logistics and minor administrative tasks.
* Flexibility for project travel and work during evenings/weekends as required by show schedules.


**Experience navigating brand/IP approval workflows is a plus**


**Physical Demands \& Travel**


* Ability to travel to and work on\-site at stores or activation locations, including nights and weekends.
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and move throughout store/event environments for extended periods.
* Capability to lift and carry props, materials, or equipment weighing up to 45 lbs.


**BENEFITS \& PERKS**

* Health Care \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Life, AD\&D, and Long\-Term Disability Insurance

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3\.7 million homes in New York City. · Maintain office supply inventory, place orders as needed, and distribute supplies to staff upon request.

· Sort incoming mail and facilitate follow\-up or action as needed.

**Preferred skills** 

· Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and effectively with members of the public and internal stakeholders.

· Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

· Demonstrated customer service skills and sound judgment when assessing inquiries and directing requests to the appropriate team.

· Ability to follow established procedures, track open items, and proactively follow up to support timely resolution.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Word, and Excel. Experience with scheduling, shared mailboxes, or case\-tracking systems is a plus.

jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Flatbush Cats is a Brooklyn\-based 501(c)(3\) nonprofit working to reduce overcrowded animal shelters in New York City and prevent more cats from ending up on the street in the first place. What began as a grassroots rescue effort has grown into a citywide organization addressing the root causes through affordable veterinary care, access to spay/neuter services, and community outreach.

As an independent nonprofit—not backed by venture capital, private equity, or a corporate veterinary network—we make decisions based on our mission. We recruit team members who are passionate about expanding access to veterinary care and measure success by how many pets and families we can help, not production targets.

At the heart of our work is **Flatbush Veterinary Clinic**, a high\-volume nonprofit clinic serving low\-income pet owners, rescue organizations, and Trap\-Neuter\-Return (TNR) volunteers throughout Brooklyn. Each year, the clinic performs more than 7,500 spay/neuter surgeries—a number that continues to grow—while providing affordable wellness and dental care to thousands of pets.

By combining high\-quality veterinary care with a commitment to accessibility, we're helping keep pets with their families while creating a city where more people and pets can receive the support they need.

**What you’ll do:**

The Community Outreach Coordinator connects Flatbush Veterinary Clinic with residents, community\-based organizations, and neighborhood leaders. This individual\-contributor role coordinates the pet food pantry, supports trusted referral networks and partnership agreements, and operates offsite outreach events. The primary goal is to expand awareness of affordable veterinary services, remove barriers to care, help pet owners schedule and complete clinic appointments, and ensure outreach activities are consistently documented and measured.

\*\*\*\* Please note: To be considered, applications must be submitted through the link provided. Applications sent via Indeed will not be reviewed.

To apply, visit: https://www.flatbushcats.org/community\-outreach\-coordinator

**Work Schedule:** 

This is a full\-time position with a Monday through Friday workweek. Occasional evening or weekend hours may be required for offsite events, with advance scheduling whenever possible.

**What you’ll get:**

**Compensation**

The hourly pay range for this role is **$36\-$40** per hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

**Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with 100% employer\-paid premiums
* Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) fully funded to cover the plan deductible, with funding levels based on coverage tier (employee\-only, employee \+ spouse, or family)
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with optional employee enrollment
* $500 annual employer contribution to the FSA, provided regardless of enrollment, plus an additional employer match of up to $500 for employees who enroll
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match: 100% match on the first 3% of contributions, plus 50% match on contributions up to 5%
* Transit and parking benefit: $60 monthly employer contribution, applicable to either transit or parking at the employee’s discretion
* Paid time off, paid sick time, and paid holidays

**Responsibilities:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Coordinate the Pet Food Pantry:** Support day\-to\-day pantry operations, including ordering, receiving, inventory and storage, eligibility and distribution processes, client communication, and accurate recordkeeping.
* **Build community relationships:** Develop trusted, culturally responsive relationships with Flatbush residents, community organizations, housing providers, schools, faith communities, businesses, and neighborhood leaders.
* **Connect pet owners with care:** Engage community members through outreach, explain available veterinary services and resources, identify barriers to care, and support appointment scheduling, follow\-through, and successful clinic visits.
* **Support community partnerships and referrals:** Maintain relationships with assigned partners, coordinate communication and referral pathways, track commitments and follow\-up, and connect community members with appropriate resources and services.
* **Coordinate mobile clinics and community outreach:** Support and execute mobile veterinary and vaccine clinics, spay/neuter booking events, food distributions, workshops, community fairs, NYCHA and tenant outreach, tabling, and other neighborhood\-based initiatives.
* **Manage event and outreach logistics:** Coordinate sites, supplies, transportation, volunteers, setup and breakdown, accessibility, appointment workflows, and post\-event follow\-up.
* **Support outreach communications:** Collaborate with clinic and communications teams to develop clear, accessible, and multilingual outreach materials, event messaging, and referral information.
* **Track outreach activities and outcomes:** Maintain accurate records related to pantry services, outreach, referrals, events, appointments, and follow\-up; gather community feedback and support program reporting and improvement.
* **Represent Flatbush Cats in the community:** Attend community meetings and partner events, share information about programs and services, gather feedback, and communicate community needs and opportunities to the team.
* Support team coordination, special projects, and other mission\-aligned responsibilities as assigned

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree in community engagement, nonprofit management, public health, social work, communications, animal welfare, or a related field preferred.
* At least two years of experience in community outreach, nonprofit programs, public health, human or animal services, community engagement, or a related field; equivalent combinations of education, volunteer service, and relevant experience are welcome.

Bluevine is the largest small business banking platform in the U.S., redefining how entrepreneurs manage their money. We create modern financial solutions, from checking and lending to payments and beyond, designed to help small business owners grow, thrive, and take control of their financial future. Our best\-in\-class technology, advanced security, and deep understanding of the small business community give our customers the confidence to focus on what they do best.

**Additional Duties as Assigned:**


* Perform additional administrative and operational duties as assigned to support team and business needs.

* 1–2 years of experience in an HR, administrative, or workplace coordination role preferred
* Course work in Human Resources a plus
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
* Professional, polished presence with a strong service mindset
* Comfortable serving as a welcoming and helpful face of the company for employees, candidates, vendors, and guests
* Comfortable working in a hybrid workplace with a minimum of two days on\-site and managing physical workspace needs
* Proficient with basic office software such as g\-suite (gmail, calendar, drive, docs)

*The benefits listed apply to full\-time positions. Benefit eligibility for part\-time positions will be explained by a member of Bluevine's Recruitment team during the interview process.*

jobs.description:
**TL;DR:** We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to run scheduling, candidate experience, and recruiting ops. You’ll work closely with recruiters, founders, and hiring managers to keep things tight, fast, and high quality from first touch through onsite and close.


As you ramp, you’ll naturally take on broader, more strategic work across the team.

**Background**


Listen Labs is the world's fastest AI research platform, built so every company can understand what their customers want, why, and what to do about it. Our AI conducts in\-depth interviews, analyzes conversations, and delivers executive\-ready insights in hours, not weeks. Born out of a Harvard research project, Listen is trusted by teams at leading brands like Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Perplexity, Sweetgreen, Replit, and Nestlé to bring real customer voices into their biggest product, marketing, and growth decisions.

**Company highlights — entirely product\-led:**

* **World\-Class Team:** Founded by serial entrepreneurs — Alfred (Bemlo, YC W22\) and Florian (IOI medalist, ICPC World Finalist) — and built with talent from Google, Meta, Tesla, Amazon, Jane Street, and X, alongside Bain, Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, and Sequoia\-backed startups like Applied Intuition, Scale AI, and Rippling. Over 30% of our team are former founders, and multiple are competitive programming medalists.
* **Hypergrowth:** Since launching, Listen has grown annualized revenue 15x and completed over 2 million interviews — backed by $100M in total funding led by Ribbit Capital, with Sequoia, Conviction, and Pear VC participating.
* **Traction:** Already serving 15% of Fortune 100s. Enterprise wins and expansions across Anthropic, Microsoft, Nestlé, Perplexity, Sweetgreen, and more — with teams telling us research that used to take six to eight weeks now happens in days.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own scheduling end\-to\-end. Make sure candidates and interviewers show up prepared and on time.
* Run a clean, thoughtful candidate experience, especially onsites. Make it feel smooth and human.
* Keep everyone in the loop. Candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers. No confusion, no dropped balls.
* Work closely with the team to unblock issues quickly and keep things moving.
* Keep Ashby accurate so we have a real view of what’s going on.
* Make things better. Fix broken workflows, tighten processes, and improve how we run.
* Take on ad hoc projects as they come up. This could help stand up a new hiring push, improve how we operate, or jump in wherever leverage is highest.

**Who You Are**

* 2\+ years in recruiting coordination, recruiting ops, or something similar in a fast\-paced environment.
* Detail\-oriented to a fault. You catch things others don’t.
* Very reliable and responsive. People trust you.
* Can juggle a lot without getting flustered.
* Care about candidate experience and making things feel seamless.
* Good judgment. Can handle sensitive info without issues.
* You like people. You’re naturally warm and easy to work with.
* You don’t wait around. If something’s broken, you fix it.
* Interested in growing into broader ownership over time.
* Experience with Ashby is helpful but not required.

**Life at Listen Labs**

* **Health, covered:** Full medical, dental, and vision. FSA/HSA and life insurance are available too.
* **Competitive compensation:** Backed by world\-class investors including Sequoia, Ribbit Capital, Conviction, and Pear VC — we hire the best and treat them accordingly, with meaningful equity ownership.


	+ The range for this role is $85,000 \- $105,000 base. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, experience, and work location. If this range doesn't match your expectations, we still encourage you to apply.
* **Annual Learning Stipend:** Books, courses, conferences, coaching, language lessons — almost anything that makes you sharper.
* **Annual Wellness Stipend for your health and headspace:** Gym memberships, race fees, massages, ergonomic gear, and more.
* **Monthly Stipend for AI tools:** A dedicated budget for the software and GPU credits that make you faster.
* **Fed, daily:** A private chef serves lunch and dinner in our SF office; NYC and London teams get daily meal credit.
* **Flexible time off:** A take\-what\-you\-need vacation policy.
* **We celebrate together:** Company offsites and events like our annual holiday party — every win is a team win.
* **Room to grow:** As an early member of the team, you'll own end\-to\-end processes from scratch and grow alongside the company.

jobs.description:
**Torres \& Zheng at Law, P.C.** is a boutique business law firm founded in 2018 and rebranded in 2023\. We serve entrepreneurs, businesses, and employers across the U.S. and China, with a strong presence in New York, New Jersey, and Atlanta (business immigration).

Our firm was built by entrepreneurs, for entrepreneurs. We are redefining legal services by breaking away from traditional law firm structures and putting clients at the center of everything we do. Our vision is to create a platform where passionate professionals can build meaningful careers, guided by the Japanese concept of *Ikigai*\-doing what you love and what you are good at. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and impact.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a hands\-on, strategic, and creative **Social Media Coordinator** to take ownership of our firm’s social media presence across both U.S. and Chinese platforms. This is not just a content\-posting role, you will be responsible for building the strategy, driving audience growth, and ultimately converting followers into clients. You will work directly with our Managing Partner, who serves as the primary on\-camera talent, to produce high\-quality, engaging video content at a pace of four posts per week across platforms including Rednote, Douyin, TikTok, Instagram, WeChat Channels, YouTube, and more.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategy \& Planning** \- Develop and execute a comprehensive social media strategy tailored to each platform, with a focus on growing our Chinese\-speaking audience and generating leads
* **Content Ideation** \- Brainstorm and pitch timely, relevant, and engaging topics that resonate with entrepreneurs and business clients in the U.S.\-China corridor
* **Content Production** \- Participate in full\-cycle video production, including filming, directing, and light editing; coordinate with a part\-time editor to ensure a steady 4\-post\-per\-week schedule
* **Growth \& Engagement** \- Research and implement best practices for algorithm optimization, audience growth, and promotional tactics; monitor analytics and adjust strategy accordingly
* **Lead Generation** \- Track and analyze how social media activity translates into client inquiries and business opportunities; propose data\-driven improvements
* **Trend Monitoring** \- Stay on top of legal industry trends, social media updates, and cultural moments to keep content fresh and relevant

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Film/Video Production, Journalism, or a related field
* 1–2 years of experience in social media coordination, content creation, or digital marketing (internships included)
* Hands\-on video production skills, comfortable with filming, lighting, and editing (experience with tools like Adobe Premiere, CapCut, Final Cut, or similar)
* Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is required, you will be creating content for Chinese\-speaking audiences and working with Chinese platforms
* Deep understanding of Chinese social media ecosystems (Rednote, Douyin, WeChat Channels) as well as U.S. platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube)
* Strong writing and communication skills in both English and Chinese
* Self\-starter with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a consistent content calendar
* In\-person availability Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM \- 7:00 PM EST

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary of **$60,000** per year
* The opportunity to build and own a social media program from the ground up
* Direct mentorship and collaboration with the firm’s Managing Partner
* A creative, entrepreneurial, and supportive team culture rooted in our core values: SCREAM (Service, Client\-Centric, Relationships, Empowerment, Accountability, Mastery)
* Real impact, your work will directly contribute to client acquisition and firm growth

**How to Apply**

Please send your resume and a portfolio or video samples to admin@torresbusinesslaw.com with the subject line: "Social Media Coordinator Application \- \[Your Name]"

Pay: $60,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Promotional & Apparel Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
A to Z Media is seeking a detail\-oriented Apparel \& Promotional Product Development Coordinator. In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of our merchandise department, executing and tracking product development, logistics, and vendor coordination for a diverse roster of music and brand clients.  

  

This role will focus on the seamless execution of merchandise programs, from initial start to final delivery. This role is ideal for a proactive, highly organized individual with a passion for music who thrives on cross\-functional collaboration, precise timeline management, and hands\-on problem solving.  

  

**What You’ll Do**  

  

**Product Development \& Timeline Tracking**  

  

\- Production Tracking \- manage the day\-to\-day product lifecycle, tracking items through the design, proofing, manufacturing, and final delivery stages  

\- Art Trafficking \- work closely with the internal Art Department to route design assets and proofs, ensuring client approvals are secured and accurate  

\- Schedule Maintenance \- maintain an up\-to\-date production calendar and generate weekly status reports to ensure all open projects stay on schedule  

\- Quality Control \- monitor pre\-production samples for quality issues, coordinate client approvals, and flag any discrepancies immediately  

  

**Vendor \& Sourcing Coordination**  

  

\- Vendor Liaison \- serve as a point of contact for our global vendor network to secure pricing, proofs, production timelines, and shipping methods  

\- Order Administration \- issue accurate Purchase Orders (POs) to vendors, confirm receipt, and monitor vendor portals for completion dates  

\- Sourcing Support \- assist in researching and vetting new vendors and manufacturers to expand apparel and promotional product options  

  

**Client Services \& Communication**  

  

\- Account Management \- maintain regular, clear communication (via email, Slack, Zoom, and phone) with clients, managers, and sales teams regarding job statuses  

\- Asset Creation \- assist in compiling internal pitch decks and monthly recaps showcasing newly developed products  

\- Issue Resolution \- act as a responsive point of contact for client claims, following established procedures to correct production or delivery errors swiftly  

  

**Logistics, Data, \& Order Administration**  

  

\- Database Accuracy \- maintain accurate and real\-time records of milestones, production notes, and shipping details within our custom database  

\- Financial Administration \- generate and issue accurate client invoices upon project completion; coordinate VAT and domestic sales tax billing with the finance team  

\- Inventory \& Warehouse Coordination \- liaise with the warehouse team to coordinate incoming shipments, pickups, physical inventory counts, and product reworks  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

\- Experience \- 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience in product coordination, apparel production, account \- management, or merchandise operations  

\- Industry Knowledge \- direct experience working within an apparel, promotional products, or music merchandise environment is highly preferred  

\- Project Management \- proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment  

\- Communication \- exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both business executives and creative artists/managers  

\- Adaptability \- high comfort level working in a dynamic environment, with a "can\-do" attitude and a knack for proactive problem\-solving  

  

**Key Skill Set**  

  

\- Extreme Attention to Detail \- inherent focus on follow\-through, database accuracy, and order precision  

\- Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- ability to act as a seamless bridge between sales, art, logistics, accounting, and external partners.  

\- Logistical Aptitude \- understanding of shipping, tracking, warehousing, and production workflows  

\- Creative Alignment \- a strong eye for product quality and design, combined with a genuine passion for music culture and artist branding.  

  

Founded in 1994, A to Z Media is a family\-owned company specializing in Vinyl, CD, DVD, Promotional Product and Apparel, and Manufacturing Services. For over 30 years, we have been committed to delivering exceptional customer service, high\-quality products, and competitive pricing for our global clientele. We work closely with clients to provide bespoke manufacturing solutions, including special printing, packaging, production, and logistical support. Our clients range from indie labels and branding agencies to distributors and Fortune 500 companies. At A to Z Media, we pride ourselves on being a true partner in bringing creative visions to life.  

  

Full\-Time, Onsite to Hybrid, $45,000 \- $65,000
