jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Global Key Account Manager, US
jobs.description:
New York, United States of America \| Full time \| Home\-based \| R1563219  
Global Key Account Manager (Sr. Director)  


Join IQVIA and help drive healthcare forward.  
IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights, and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections across healthcare through advanced analytics, technology, data, and deep domain expertise—helping customers accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments that improve patient outcomes worldwide.  


We are seeking a Global Key Account Manager (Senior Director) to lead the strategic relationship with a major global account. In this highly visible commercial leadership role, you will drive revenue growth across IQVIA offerings and service lines, shape global account strategy, and orchestrate cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions that address complex client priorities.  


You will partner with senior stakeholders, deepen relationships across the client organization, identify new areas of opportunity, and position IQVIA as a strategic partner. Success in this role requires strong executive presence, commercial acumen, and the ability to connect client needs with IQVIA’s broad portfolio of data, technology, analytics, clinical, and commercial capabilities.  


What You’ll Be Doing  


Develop and execute a global account strategy aligned to IQVIA Health priorities, client objectives, and long\-term growth opportunities.  
Build and sustain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, executive sponsors, and decision makers across the account.  
Expand and deepen engagement across the client organization, including identifying new audiences, influencers, and strategic partnership opportunities.  
Drive customer satisfaction, secure key renewals, and grow sustainable revenue streams across IQVIA offerings and service lines.  
Lead global, regional, functional, and business\-unit account teams to build a strong opportunity pipeline and deliver coordinated client engagement.  
Leverage internal best practices, market insights, and cross\-functional expertise to identify new business opportunities and improve account performance.  
Assess business risks and market changes that could impact the account relationship, including competitive dynamics, client strategy, portfolio priorities, and R\&D pipeline shifts.  
Orchestrate internal resources, remove barriers, and align teams around innovative solutions that support renewals, expansion, and strategic growth.  
Position IQVIA Health as a strategic partner across primary solution areas and emerging capabilities.  
Contribute input to solution development, thought leadership, and new business partnerships for large pharmaceutical accounts.  
Introduce and position new IQVIA Health assets, acquisitions, and capabilities with relevant client stakeholders.  
Personally lead strategic global or multi\-country opportunities that are critical to achieving account plan and financial goals.  
Mentor account leaders and junior colleagues, helping strengthen performance, commercial discipline, and leadership capability.  


What We’re Looking For  


Experience  


10\+ years of experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, commercial services, or a related industry.  
Demonstrated success managing large, complex, global strategic accounts.  
Proven ability to grow revenue by selling complex, multi\-service solutions across a broad portfolio of capabilities.  
Track record of balancing near\-term opportunity execution with long\-term strategic account development.  
Experience navigating global matrixed organizations and managing multiple sophisticated client relationships simultaneously.  


Skills and Capabilities  


Executive presence and credibility with C\-suite, senior commercial, and strategic decision makers.  
Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and opportunity management skills across the full sales cycle.  
Ability to translate client priorities into clear account plans, measurable actions, and disciplined execution.  
Strong financial acumen, including forecasting, pipeline management, revenue planning, and account performance reporting.  
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.  
Collaborative leadership style with the ability to influence across functions, geographies, and business units.  
High degree of ownership, accountability, resilience, and self\-motivation.  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.  


What We Offer  


At IQVIA, you will work alongside talented colleagues across a global organization to help customers solve complex healthcare challenges. You will have opportunities to grow your career through exposure to diverse geographies, client priorities, technologies, service lines, and therapeutic areas—while contributing to work that supports better patient outcomes and population health worldwide.  


IQVIA fosters a culture of belonging where colleagues are encouraged to bring their perspectives, collaborate across teams, and do meaningful work that helps advance healthcare.  


If you are a strategic account leader who thrives in complex global client environments and wants to help move healthcare forward, we encourage you to apply.  


Please note: To be eligible for this remote position, you must reside in the country where the role is posted.  


IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Octus**



Octus is a leading global provider of credit intelligence, data, and analytics. Since 2013, tens of thousands of professionals across hedge fund, investment banking, management consulting, and law firm verticals have come to rely on Octus to make better, faster, and more confident decisions in pace with the fast\-moving credit markets.
  

For more information, visit: https://octus.com/


**Working at Octus**



Octus hires growth\-minded innovators and trailblazers across the globe to drive our business and culture. Our core values – Action Oriented, Customer First Mindset, Effective Team Players, and Driven to Excel – define an organizational ethos that's as high\-performing as it is human. Among other perks, Octus employees enjoy competitive health benefits, matched 401k and pension plans, PTO, generous parental leave, gym subsidies, educational reimbursements for career development, recognition programs, and much more.  

  

**Role**


We are looking for an Implementation Specialist to own the onboarding experience for our clients, guiding them from signed contract through scoping and implementation, and into a strong long\-term partnership. You will work to configure the LevPro platform (Research Management, Trading Tools/OMS, Portfolio Management, Compliance) around each client's workflows, manage data migrations and back\-office interfaces, and train new users so they can hit the ground running. You will coordinate closely with the sales, data, customer success and product development teams to identify, create and support the best solutions for our clients. This is a highly cross\-functional, client\-facing role for someone who enjoys turning complex requirements into scalable, customer\-focused solutions.

  



LevPro, now part of Octus, is a modern operating system for leveraged credit asset managers, founded to modernize a $1\.5 trillion finance sector where highly skilled professionals still populate spreadsheets from unstructured emails, manually match names to identifiers, and work off text documents. We use artificial intelligence (and a little magic) to solve a number of data, nomenclature, and workflow problems that have plagued this industry, resulting in a massively improved user experience. Our single code base allows us to iterate at a rapid pace, which also results in industry\-leading customer response times. Our platform has enjoyed strong adoption across the Alternative Asset industry, with many of our clients transitioning away from the legacy software they've been using for years. We're looking to bolster our talented team with the addition of key strategic hires to support growth.

  


**Responsibilities**


* Own end\-to\-end onboarding for new clients, from scoping and project kickoff, through to go\-live, keeping each project on schedule and within scope
* Translate client's existing workflows and requirements into system configuration, documenting and explaining relevant details to clients and executing on the implementation
* Coordinate and test third\-party integrations, working closely with engineering and third parties
* Lead training sessions and build out general documentation/FAQs so client teams can use system independently
* Troubleshoot and resolve client issues keeping clients informed throughout
* Partner with sales to ensure a seamless handoff and set the foundation for a strong long\-term relationship
* Identify and flag opportunities to improve implementation tools, processes and LevPro products

  


**Requirements**


* 5\-7 years of experience in client\-facing software implementation and/or project management, ideally within fintech, SaaS, or financial services, including 3\-5 years of relevant experience in Leveraged Credit / Fixed Income
* High proficiency in software systems, data tools (e.g., Excel, etc.), and advanced proficiency with using AI models (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)
* Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple concurrent client implementations
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to build client trust and credibility quickly as a knowledgeable partner, while at times pushing back on requests that don't align with the product roadmap
* Self\-starter who is comfortable in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and will push back constructively when needed

  


**What We Offer**


* Competitive pay and benefits
* As much opportunity and responsibility as you can handle
* A flexible, remote or in office work model
* A highly collaborative and dynamic group environment
* A stipend for learning (books, classes, etc.)

  



At Octus, we consider a range of factors in connection with compensation decisions, including experience, skills, location, and our business needs and limitations. As a result, compensation may vary within and across similar roles and positions. Please note that the salary range information below is a good faith estimate for this position and actual compensation for any individual may fall outside this range if warranted by the circumstances applicable to that individual. If we identify a role that would be suitable for a broader range of skills and experience such that we would consider hiring at multiple levels then the range listed below may reflect that breadth.



The salary range estimate for this position is **$110,000 \- $120,000\.**



The actual compensation will be at Octus' sole discretion and will be determined by the aforementioned and other relevant factors.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**



Octus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other legally protected stat

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Take2:**
================


Take2 is an AI agents platform purpose\-built for healthcare recruiting. Take2’s agent network automates the end\-to\-end recruiting process, from sourcing and screening to credential verification, scheduling, and onboarding.


We work with enterprise healthcare customers, including some of the largest health systems in the USA.

**What you will do:**
=====================

* Own a portfolio of enterprise health system accounts end to end, from post\-sale kickoff through implementation, adoption, renewal, and expansion
* Lead AI agent implementations in large healthcare systems: scoping workflows with recruiting and TA leaders, configuring AI interviewers and integrations, and driving pilots to measurable outcomes like reduced time\-to\-fill
* Drive adoption on the ground, training and enabling recruiters, building champions, and turning skeptics into power users across large, distributed teams
* Be the voice of the customer internally, translating what you see in the field into product feedback and working directly with founders and engineering to shape the roadmap
* Own retention and growth metrics for your book, including renewals, expansion into new roles, departments, and facilities, and executive business reviews with health system leadership
* Shape the customer success engine, building the playbooks, onboarding processes, and health metrics we'll scale with

**Who you are:**
================

* You have 4\+ years in customer success, implementation, or account management for B2B SaaS, with at least 2 years owning enterprise accounts ($100k\+ ACV) and carrying renewal or expansion targets
* You've worked with healthcare organizations (health systems, hospitals, or healthcare staffing) or in HR tech / talent acquisition software, and can speak credibly to recruiting leaders about their workflows
* You've led complex implementations involving multiple stakeholders, integrations, and change management, and you know adoption is won in the field, not in the kickoff deck
* You can navigate large, multi\-threaded organizations, from a recruiter on the front line to a CHRO in a business review
* You are confident working with limited process or infrastructure (and excited to help us build it out as we grow)
* You are analytical and rigorous: you track account health, forecast renewals accurately, keep clean CRM records (HubSpot preferred), and use AI tools to work smarter
* You are comfortable with emerging AI products, curious about how they work, and able to set the right expectations with customers about what agents can and can't do

**Why Take2 AI**
================

* High ownership over revenue and customer relationships
* Direct access to founders and influence on customer success strategy
* Opportunity to help define how Take2 retains and grows customers as we scale
* Mission\-driven product that improves hiring outcomes for companies and candidates
* Clear growth path into senior CS or leadership roles

**Location \& Flexibility**
===========================


We’re NYC\-based and work hybrid (in\-office Mon\-Thu). We value in\-person collaboration but also trust people to manage their time responsibly.

**Compensation \& Growth**
==========================


Competitive salary \+ meaningful equity. This is a chance to join at a stage where your work meaningfully shapes the product and your career trajectory.


Compensation Range: $100K \- $150K

jobs.title: Strategic Finance & Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**Strategic Finance \& Business Operations Lead**
=================================================


Blossom Health exists to **solve the mental health epidemic** in America by partnering with psychiatrists to expand access to affordable, timely, clinically\-effective mental healthcare. Our **AI\-native care platform** is loved by hundreds of clinicians and thousands of patients.


We’re a **Series A** company with **$20M\+ raised** from Headline, Village Global, and the founders of General Catalyst, Flatiron Health, Sword Health, Grow Therapy, Fay, Elemy, Zip, Blank Street, Assured, Bridge, Birches Health, and Enzo Health.

**The Role:**
=============


We’re looking for a **Strategic Finance \& Business Operations Lead** to own the financial and analytical work behind some of Blossom’s most important business decisions.


This is **not a generalist BizOps role**. You’ll spend a significant amount of your time digging into the economics of the business: understanding our revenue structure, building financial models, evaluating new opportunities, and turning complex financial and operational data into decisions.


You’ll report directly to our Founder and work closely with leaders across the company as we scale.

**Why You Should Work Here:**
=============================

* **Be early in a hyper\-growth startup:** Join the foundational team of a rapidly scaling company and help build the financial and operational infrastructure behind our next stage of growth
* **Work on decisions that matter:** Your analysis won’t live in a deck. You’ll help answer questions that directly influence how we grow, where we invest, and how we build the business
* **High trust and autonomy:** Own meaningful work from day one, with the freedom to shape how problems are approached and solved
* **Talent\-dense team:** Work alongside a top\-percentile team with high standards, intellectual curiosity, and a shared ambition to build something consequential
* **We move with speed and purpose:** We value people who can move quickly, get deep into the details, and turn analysis into action

**What You'll Do:**
===================

* Own financial analysis and modeling across revenue, growth, unit economics, and strategic initiatives
* Develop a deep understanding of Blossom’s revenue structure and identify opportunities to improve the economics of the business
* Build models and analyses that inform company\-level decisions around growth, investment, resource allocation, and new opportunities
* Partner with the Founder and business leaders on high\-priority strategic and operational projects
* Translate complex financial and operational data into clear recommendations and actionable decisions
* Build reporting, forecasting, and analytical processes as the company scales
* Evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, markets, and strategic initiatives from both a financial and operational perspective
* Move beyond the analysis when needed and help execute on the opportunities you identify

**You'll Be a Good Fit If:**
============================

* You have **2–6 years of professional experience**, with a strong foundation in finance and financial analysis
* You have experience in **investment banking, equity research, private equity, hedge funds, or another rigorous investing/financial environment**
* You’re exceptionally strong in financial modeling and comfortable getting deep into revenue structures, unit economics, and business performance
* You have a track record of outperforming in highly selective, demanding environments
* You can take a complicated or ambiguous question, structure it quickly, and arrive at a thoughtful answer
* You’re commercially minded. You care about what the numbers actually mean for the business, not just producing the analysis
* You have a strong bias for action and are excited to operate beyond the traditional boundaries of a finance role
* You communicate clearly and can turn detailed analysis into a compelling recommendation
* You’re excited by the opportunity to work directly with a Founder and take on increasingly broad ownership as the company grows
* You’re authorized to work in the United States
* You’re excited to be **in\-person in New York City 5 days a week**

**Bonus:** You’ve spent several years in investment banking or another rigorous finance environment and have since moved into strategic finance, business operations, or a similar role at a high\-growth startup.

**What We're Looking For:**
===========================

* **Highly motivated, ambitious, and capable** \- you want to tackle large, meaningful problems and hold yourself to a high bar
* **Ownership mindset** \- you think long\-term and put the business and our customers first
* **High velocity and high excellence** \- you move with urgency without sacrificing the quality of your work
* **Analytically rigorous** \- you’re comfortable going several layers deeper than the obvious answer
* **Commercially curious** \- you want to understand how and why a business works, not just report what happened
* **An explorer** \- you’re comfortable with ambiguity, autonomy, and questions that don’t have an existing playbook
* **Humble** \- you use your strengths in service of the team and understand that success is an output, not an input

**Compensation \& Benefits:**
=============================

* **$120,000–$180,000 base salary**
* Meaningful equity ownership
* Significant growth opportunities as the company scales
* Beautiful, sunshine and snack\-filled office in the heart of Flatiron, Manhattan
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* A focus on outcomes, not hours
* Team outings, offsites, and unlimited PTO


Compensation Range: $120K \- $180K

jobs.title: Part Time Retail Operations Associate, SANDRO Williamsburg
jobs.description:
SMCP \- Sandro, Maje, Claudie Pierlot

**Part Time Operations Associate at SMCP (SANDRO)**


**Location:** SANDRO, Williamsburg Brooklyn



 At SMCP, we embody the essence of Parisian elegance with our renowned brands, Sandro and Maje. With a commitment to accessible luxury, we bring high\-fashion designs and sustainability together, crafting exceptional products and memorable experiences. Operating in over 47 countries, we are financially stable and in an exciting phase of growth, led by a strong and experienced senior leadership team. Our culture thrives on engagement, inclusivity, and corporate social responsibility, ensuring that our success is built on both innovation and care for our planet. By 2030, we aim to meet ambitious sustainability goals, all while offering Parisian chic with a modern twist. Our collections reflect the dynamic interplay of casual elegance and evening sophistication, created for individuals who value both style and sustainability.



**Why SMCP:**



SMCP is more than just a fashion house—it's a forward\-thinking company where innovation and sustainability come together. As we continue to lead the accessible luxury market, we focus on growth, stability, and prioritizing internal mobility for our people. With a dedicated senior leadership team guiding us, we offer a culture that fosters creativity, engagement, and meaningful career opportunities. Our collections from Sandro and Maje blend timeless Parisian style with a contemporary edge, allowing individuals to express their unique personality through fashion. Joining SMCP means becoming part of an evolving story, where passion, creativity, and sustainability are at the forefront. Together, we will continue shaping the future of fashion with a strong foundation of growth, stability, and engagement.



To learn more about our global presence and values, visit our website at SMCP Global.



**At SMCP, We Style Happiness at Work—Lead with Passion and Purpose!**



 As an **Operations Associate**, you'll play a pivotal role in driving the store's operational efficiency while supporting the customer experience from behind the scenes. Your attention to detail, problem\-solving skills, and passion for sales operations will help create seamless and effective back\-of\-house processes. You'll lead and manage the back\-of\-house team to ensure flawless execution of merchandise processing, inventory control, and store organization.



By working closely with your team, you'll ensure operations run smoothly, allowing the customer\-facing aspects of the store to shine. In addition to overseeing day\-to\-day operations, you'll assist with key tasks such as managing inventory, ensuring compliance with store procedures, and supporting visual merchandising efforts.



While your primary focus will be on back\-of\-house functions, your contributions will have a direct impact on the customer shopping experience by enhancing overall store efficiency. No two days will be the same, offering you the opportunity to influence store performance and contribute to team success in a dynamic environment.



**What You'll Do:**


**Leadership \& Operational Excellence**


* Lead by example in all back\-of\-house operations, setting high standards for efficiency, accuracy, and attention to detail across all tasks.
* Ensure seamless coordination between back\-of\-house and sales floor operations to support overall store performance.


**Inventory Management \& Merchandise Processing**


* Oversee all inventory processes, including merchandise check\-in, stock processing, store\-to\-store transfers, markdowns, RTVs (Return to Vendor), and liquidation.
* Implement procedures to ensure timely and accurate stock handling, minimizing errors and maximizing efficiency.


**Visual Merchandising \& Product Presentation**


* Manage visual merchandising processes such as floor sets, product replenishment, and ongoing maintenance to uphold brand standards.
* Collaborate with the sales team to ensure merchandise displays are visually appealing and aligned with current promotions and trends.


**Asset Protection \& Inventory Control**


* Implement and monitor asset protection strategies to minimize inventory loss and prevent shrinkage.
* Oversee accurate and timely physical inventory counts, ensuring compliance with company standards and protocols.


**Stockroom Organization \& Safety Compliance**


* Maintain an organized, efficient stockroom, ensuring all back\-of\-house areas are clean, accessible, and compliant with safety regulations.
* Promote best practices for stock handling and storage to support smooth operations and maintain a safe work environment.


**Sales Floor Support \& Customer Engagement**


* Provide support on the sales floor as needed, assisting with POS operations and ensuring a smooth checkout process.
* Greet and engage customers when required, contributing to an exceptional shopping experience and reinforcing brand values.


 **Who You Are:**

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Location: Hybrid NYC


About MediaRadar
MediaRadar, now including the data and capabilities of Vivvix, powers the mission\-critical marketing and sales decisions that drive competitive advantage. Our competitive advertising intelligence platform enables clients to achieve peak performance with always\-on data and insights that span the media, creative, and business strategies of five million brands across 30\+ media channels. By bringing the advertising past, present, and future into focus, our clients rapidly act on the competitive moves and emerging advertising trends impacting their business.


The Role


We are looking for a driven, creative, and resourceful Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our high\-performing demand generation team, specifically focusing on our Brands and Agencies business.


In this role, you will be the engine of our sales funnel, responsible for generating qualified pipeline through strategic outreach and meaningful prospect engagement. You will work in a fast\-paced, consultative environment, acting as a key contributor to our revenue growth by identifying and connecting with key stakeholders at leading agencies and brands


Key Responsibilities: What You’ll Do


Drive High\-Quality Pipeline Growth

* Strategically prospect into enterprise and mid\-market target accounts across the Brand and Agency landscape.
* Conduct multi\-threaded outreach using a mix of channels including phone, email, video, and social, utilizing personalization at scale.
* Identify key stakeholders and decision\-makers, navigating complex org charts to understand account dynamics.
* Book high\-conversion meetings that turn into real pipeline, working closely with Account Executives to ensure a seamless lead handoff.
* Meet and exceed quotas related to monthly outreach, meetings booked, and pipeline generation.


Sales Strategy \& Execution

* Qualify leads effectively by leveraging prospecting frameworks such as Sandler, ANUM, MEDDICC, or SPIN Selling.
* Utilize sales technology (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, Orum, HubSpot, and Salesforce) to manage your workflow and track activity.
* Maintain strong sales hygiene and data integrity to support accurate forecasting and reporting.


Research \& Personalization

* Conduct in\-depth research on target brands and agencies to inform tailored messaging and value propositions.
* Track industry trends within media, advertising, and technology to connect prospect challenges to MediaRadar’s unique value.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Marketing and RevOps to align strategies and improve conversion rates across the funnel.

  

**Requirements**  

* Experience: 1–3 years of experience in outbound sales or business development, preferably in SaaS, MarTech, AdTech, or data\-driven B2B environments.
* Industry Knowledge: A strong understanding of advertising, media buying/selling, and how brands make marketing decisions.
* Tech Savvy: Proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce/HubSpot) and sales engagement platforms.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal storytelling skills with a knack for active listening.
* Mindset: You are a proactive thinker, exceptionally organized, and motivated by measurable results and personal growth.

  

**Benefits**  

In addition to career progression, training and development, and an excellent work/life balance, future Radarians can expect a great benefits package that includes:

* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* 401k with Company Match
* Flexible PTO
* Commuter Benefits
* Paid Parental Leave
* Summer Fridays


At MediaRadar, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone can thrive. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences makes us stronger and more innovative. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.


In accordance with the EEO\-1 reporting requirements, we collect demographic data as part of our efforts to ensure fair and equitable hiring practices across all levels of our organization. This is a full\-time exempt role with a base salary range of $55,000 \- $70,000, plus benefits.


We are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is accessible to all applicants. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at careers@mediaradar.com .


We’re excited to meet people who share our values and want to build the future with us!

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, Healthcare
jobs.description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.


We're looking for a Business Development Representative to help grow CLEAR's Healthcare business by building pipeline and creating qualified opportunities with healthcare organizations and prospective partners. You'll combine thoughtful prospecting, compelling storytelling, and curiosity about our customers to introduce healthcare leaders to CLEAR's identity solutions and help make healthcare experiences safer and easier.

  


***What you'll do:***


* Own pipeline generation across inbound and outbound channels, consistently creating high\-quality opportunities for CLEAR's Healthcare business
* Prospect and engage healthcare decision\-makers through strategic, personalized outreach across email, phone, social selling, and other channels
* Understand prospective customers, their needs, their challenges, and the healthcare landscape to clearly articulate how CLEAR's identity solutions can create value
* Partner closely with Sales and Account Executives to qualify prospects, uncover opportunities, and build pipeline that converts into revenue
* Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Product to sharpen messaging and go\-to\-market strategies, using data and insights to continuously improve outreach, conversion, and efficiency

  


***How you'll measure success:***


* Qualified healthcare pipeline generated and influenced against quarterly targets
* Achievement of outbound activity, response, meeting conversion, and opportunity generation targets
* Revenue contribution from sourced opportunities, including pipeline quality, velocity, and conversion to closed\-won business
* Demonstrated expertise in CLEAR's identity solutions, target customers, and the healthcare landscape

  


***What you're great at:***


* Building relationships through excellent written, verbal, and listening skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and communicate a compelling value proposition
* Taking ownership of your goals with a self\-starter mindset, persistence, curiosity, and a bias for action in a fast\-paced, evolving environment
* Using data and a process\-oriented approach to understand performance, identify opportunities, and continuously improve prospecting and outbound strategies

### **About Reducto**


Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams who demand enterprise performance at scale. We provide a comprehensive toolkit for working with documents the way a human would, combining custom in\-house and leading frontier models to power efficient and accurate document workflows.


We’ve grown rapidly, increasing revenue 8x year over year and partnering with hundreds of companies, from leading AI teams like Harvey, Vanta, and Scale, to enterprise customers across FAANG and top trading firms.


Reducto has raised over $100M from world\-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital.

As an early member of our GTM team, you'll own our outbound strategy and have the responsibility of generating pipeline during this period of rapid scale. For the right candidate, this role offers a clear path to progress into an Account Executive position as we expand our GTM org.

### **We would love to meet you if the following resonates:**

* **You’re Scrappy:** You're tenacious and creative in finding ways to reach the right customers. You don't just follow playbooks – you write them. We want someone who spots opportunities others miss and isn't afraid to run scrappy experiments to prove out new channels.
* **You Get Technical Buyers:** You have 2\+ years of experience as a BDR or in a Growth role, ideally selling technical products to technical buyers
* **You’re an Exceptional Communicator:** You can speak the language of technical buyers and quickly grasp their needs. You're exceptional at both written and verbal communication.
* **You’re Extremely Organized and Process Oriented:** You’re incredibly organized and follow a strict process to maintain CRM cleanliness and keep track of experiments you’re running and the results.
* **You Know Sales Dev Best Practices:** In short, this isn’t your first rodeo. You’ve tried all the tools, know the messaging best practices and know how to scale an outbound effort without getting your inbox(es) spammed.

### **The core work will include:**


80% of Time

* Building and executing creative outbound campaigns to generate qualified leads
* Setting up and optimizing new lead generation channels through content and marketing experiments


20% of Time

* Building basic sales processes / tracking of efforts in CRM
* Supporting deals from initial contact through to close
* Creating content that resonates with technical decision makers

### **Bonus points if you:**

* Have experience selling ML/AI or developer tools
* Have previously worked at a high\-growth startup
* Bring established relationships in the ML/AI ecosystem
* Have a technical background or strong interest in AI/ML
* Have demonstrated success in previous BDR roles with clear metrics


This is an in person role at our office in NYC. We’re an early stage company which means that the role requires working hard and moving quickly. Please only apply if that excites you.

**About Reducto**
-----------------

*Nearly 80% of enterprise data is in unstructured formats like PDFs*


PDFs are the status quo for enterprise knowledge in nearly every industry. Insurance claims, financial statements, invoices, and health records are all stored in a structure that’s simply impractical for use in digital workflows. This isn’t an inconvenience—it’s a critical bottleneck that leads to dozens of wasted hours every week.

*Traditional approaches fail at reliably extracting information in complex PDFs*


OCR and even more sophisticated ML approaches work for simple text documents but are unreliable for anything more complex. Text from different columns are jumbled together, figures are ignored, and tables are a nightmare to get right. Overcoming this usually requires a large engineering effort dedicated to building specialized pipelines for every document type you work with.

**Reducto** **breaks document layouts into subsections and then contextually parses each depending on the type of content.** This is made possible by a combination of vision models, LLMs, and a suite of heuristics we built over time. Put simply, we can help you:

* Accurately extract text and tables even with nonstandard layouts
* Automatically convert graphs to tabular data and summarize images in documents
* Extract important fields from complex forms with simple, natural language instructions
* Build powerful retrieval pipelines using Reducto’s document metadata
* Intelligently chunk information using the document’s layout data

**Benefits at Reducto**
-----------------------

*At Reducto, we’re invested in the well\-being and growth of our team. Here’s what we currently offer:*

* **Unlimited PTO:** We believe great work requires recharging.
* **Lunch:** Receive a free lunch to eat with your teammates daily at the office
* **Reimbursed Transportation:** Provide us with your receipts and we’ll take care of the costs
* **Insurance**: Generous health insurance covering medical, dental, and vision.
* **Health and Wellness Budget:** We provide up to $150/mo reimbursement for health and wellness spending, such as gym memberships, fitness classes, or similar.
* **Parental Leave:** Work with us to build a leave schedule that works for you and your family
* **401k \+ 4%** company match

jobs.title: Electrical Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Title: Electrical Project Coordinator

Department: Operations

Reports To: Project Manager or Senior Project Manager

FLSA Status: Non\-Exempt

Location:

Position Summary:

The Project Coordinator provides essential administrative and operational support to the project management team for large\-scale commercial and industrial electrical projects. This role focuses on organizing project documentation, supporting project accounting functions, coordinating internal and external communications, and maintaining accurate records to ensure project delivery is on time, within scope, and aligned with company financial goals.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Administration \& Documentation:

· Create, organize, and maintain project folders (physical and digital), ensuring proper version control and accessibility.

· Track and manage submittals, RFIs, transmittals, and change order documentation.

· Coordinate the flow of information between project team members, subcontractors, and clients.

· Prepare meeting agendas, capture minutes, and distribute action items.

Accounting \& Cost Tracking:

· Assist project managers with coding, reviewing, and processing invoices, purchase orders, and subcontractor billings.

· Track committed costs, change order logs, and project budgets in collaboration with accounting and PMs.

· Support monthly project forecasting and cost\-to\-complete processes.

· Maintain project time tracking and labor reporting as required.

Compliance \& Document Control:

· Ensure proper documentation of safety reports, daily logs, jobsite photos, and inspection reports.

· Maintain up\-to\-date project records in accordance with contractual and company standards.

· Track and maintain insurance certificates, lien waivers, permits, and other compliance\-related documents.

Communication \& Coordination:

· Coordinate and schedule project meetings, inspections, and deliveries.

· Act as a liaison between the field team, project management, and office support.

· Support onboarding of subcontractors and vendors, ensuring required documentation is collected and filed.

Qualifications:

Education \& Experience:

· Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Construction Management, Accounting, or related field preferred.

· 2\+ years of experience in construction administration, electrical contracting, or a similar field required.

Skills \& Competencies:

· Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail.

· Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and document management platforms (e.g., Procore, PlanGrid, SharePoint).

· Familiarity with construction accounting software (e.g., Viewpoint Vista, Sage 300, or similar) is a plus.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Ability to multitask and manage shifting priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

Working Conditions:

· Primarily office\-based with occasional visits to active job sites.

· May require extended hours during key project phases.

Success Factors:

· Highly reliable and self\-motivated with a strong sense of urgency and accountability.

· Team\-oriented with a service\-first mindset toward project teams and field operations.

· Diligent record\-keeper and process enforcer who thrives in structured environments.

Pay: $58,190\.48 \- $70,078\.87 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: SAP Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Syskoplan Reply is a part of the Reply Network, focused on delivering transformative projects to our clients leveraging SAP solutions. Syskoplan Reply is an SAP Gold partner and has recognized expertise executing global projects in various industries and a wide range of competencies including business process consulting, customer experience, intelligent automation, ERP and more.



The Project Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting the administrative functions required to successfully execute a range of SAP technology\-based projects. Working with the Project Manager or on smaller projects individually, the Project Coordinator supports the project plan and is responsible for ensuring accuracy and timeliness of associated project deliverables, including communication of status, risks and issues to the relevant team members. A successful candidate must be extremely organized and can thrive in a fast paced, deadline\-oriented SAP project environment.



### **Responsibilities**

* Maintaining standard project documentation such as project plan, travel plans, team roster, status reports, risks and issue logs, budget reports, presentations etc.
* Support testing coordination and defect management activities within SAP Cloud ALM, including monitoring test progress, logging and prioritizing defects, and following up with teams to drive timely resolution.
* Set up and organization of project document repository
* Recording minutes during project, team, and steering committee meetings and gathering related information for project documentation, storing documentation
* Management of change requests to the project plan and other project management documentation
* Provision of seamless communication, planning business activities with clients and stakeholders
* Schedule and organize project team meetings
* Coordination of third\-party activities in relation to project execution
* Other administrative tasks as assigned

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 1\-2 years relevant experience
* Travel up to 50%
* SAP prior knowledge or software implementation experience
* Excellent oral, written and interpersonal communication skills. Must be able to communicate effectively and professionally with external contacts or employees, including senior executives, international and domestic team members
* Organizational and administrative skills to enable the maintenance and storage of electronic project files
* Strong knowledge and experience using the Microsoft Office Suite including competence in advance features of Microsoft Office programs. Detailed knowledge of capabilities of Microsoft Teams and SharePoint or a willingness to gain and maintain such knowledge so it can be applied to the management of projects.
* Manage multiple priorities by using appropriate methodologies and tools. Experience with successfully managing complex project and program delivery
* Ability to understand basic technical conversations in meetings and be able to take notes on the details being discussed

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* SmartSheet experience
* A knowledge of various project methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, SAP Activate) is desirable or willingness to learn


About Reply



Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services.

The base compensation range for this full\-time position is between $75,000 \- $120,000 plus benefits. Compensation decisions are supported through market data, where regional variances may exist based on cost of labor. We also take into consideration prior experience, relevant skills, education and/or training, certifications and, as applicable, other required qualifications. If you have questions regarding compensation, the talent acquisition team can provide relevant details during the interview process.

Reply is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to provide equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you need assistance and reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, email us at jobusa@reply.com. Visit our website at www.reply.com to learn more about our open roles.

jobs.title: RN PROGRAM COORDINATOR – CNA TRAINING PROGRAM
jobs.description:
RN PROGRAM COORDINATOR – CNA TRAINING PROGRAM

**Job Type:** Part\-Time / Contract  
**Schedule:** Flexible  
**Location:** Atlanta/College Park, Georgia Area  
**Compensation:** Negotiable Monthly Contract Fee

POSITION SUMMARY

A developing **Georgia Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) training program** is seeking an experienced, dependable, and organized **Georgia Registered Nurse (RN)** to serve as **RN Program Coordinator**.

This is a **part\-time/contract opportunity** ideal for an RN with experience in nursing education, CNA training, long\-term care, skilled nursing, or program oversight who is interested in supporting a growing healthcare education program without committing to a traditional full\-time position.

PROGRAM COORDINATOR RESPONSIBILITIES

The RN Program Coordinator will provide professional oversight and assist with maintaining the CNA training program in accordance with applicable **Georgia Department of Community Health (DCH)** requirements.

Responsibilities may include:

* Provide professional RN oversight of the CNA training program.
* Assist with ensuring compliance with applicable Georgia DCH requirements.
* Review curriculum, lesson plans, policies, procedures, and training standards.
* Provide oversight and guidance to CNA instructors.
* Assist with maintaining appropriate instructor and student training documentation.
* Monitor classroom, laboratory, skills, and clinical components for program compliance.
* Assist with evaluation of student clinical and skills competency requirements.
* Participate in program evaluations and quality\-improvement activities.
* Assist with preparation for DCH reviews, surveys, audits, and required program documentation.
* Serve as an RN resource regarding clinical education and appropriate standards of care.
* Help ensure students receive training consistent with approved CNA program requirements.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Current, unrestricted **Georgia Registered Nurse (RN) license**.
* Nursing experience with strong clinical knowledge.
* Strong organizational, leadership, and communication skills.
* Ability to maintain and review regulatory and educational documentation.
* Dependable and able to provide consistent program oversight.
* Passion for educating and developing future healthcare professionals.

TRAIN\-THE\-TRAINER EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Applicants **must have completed or possess qualifying Train\-the\-Trainer preparation/experience applicable to Georgia nurse aide training requirements.**

Experience as a **CNA/Nurse Aide Program Coordinator, RN Instructor, Staff Development Coordinator, or Nurse Educator** is strongly preferred.

Experience in **long\-term care, skilled nursing, geriatrics, or CNA education** is highly desirable.

COMPENSATION

**Negotiable Monthly Contract Fee**

This is not intended to be a traditional full\-time RN position. Compensation is negotiable based on experience, Train\-the\-Trainer qualifications, previous CNA/Nurse Aide program experience, and the level of ongoing program involvement required. This is a part\-time independent contract opportunity and is not a traditional full\-time RN position.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

We are looking for an RN who understands that CNA education is about more than teaching skills. The right candidate will value **compassion, competence, dignity, professionalism, and excellence** and will help prepare future CNAs to provide quality, person\-centered care.

**Interested candidates should submit a résumé outlining RN experience, nursing education/CNA training experience, and Train\-the\-Trainer qualifications for consideration.**

Pay: $750\.00 \- $2,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional email and phone etiquette.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to conduct online research.
* Comfortable communicating with executives, physicians, business owners, and philanthropic leaders.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism.
* Passion for women's leadership, education, healthcare, or nonprofit development.
* Previous fundraising, sales, development, customer relations, or nonprofit experience is **required**.

Preferred Skills

* Donor prospect research
* Grant/foundation research
* Corporate sponsorship outreach
* CRM/database management
* Email marketing
* LinkedIn outreach
* Relationship management
* Fundraising campaign development
* Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets
* Google Workspace

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

**Relationship\-Oriented:** Enjoys building genuine professional relationships.

**Persistent:** Understands that donor development requires consistent follow\-up.

**Professional:** Can confidently communicate with physicians, executives, business owners, foundations, and community leaders.

**Organized:** Can accurately track prospects, communications, meetings, and donations.

**Mission\-Driven:** Believes in expanding opportunities for women pursuing careers in medicine.

**Volunteer Position:** This is currently an unpaid volunteer leadership/development position.

Opportunities for increased responsibility, professional development, leadership experience, recognition, and advancement within the organization may be available based on performance and organizational needs.

What You Will Gain

* Nonprofit fundraising experience
* Donor relationship management experience

* Professional networking opportunities
* Experience communicating with executives and healthcare professionals

jobs.description:
As an entry\-level **Account Coordinator** on the OEM FordDirect Team for Team Velocity, you must possess superior communication skills and have working knowledge of Agency\-Client relationships and processes. You work closely with Regional Account Managers (RAMs), Production, OEM and Onboarding team members to ensure timely deliverables. You will develop and maintain a working\-level understanding of the automotive industry, company culture, products, services, strategic communication planning and integrated marketing strategies. You are highly organized, task and detail\-oriented, motivated, articulate, flexible, and capable of working under pressure. You are driven to provide the highest level of customer service. Your academic and professional experience has instilled a sense of urgency without compromising the integrity of results.


***This is an entry\-level, remote, full\-time, salaried, position. Candidate must reside within the continental U.S., EASTERN or CENTRAL time zones highly preferred.***

**Ideal Candidate**  

You understand integrated marketing strategies, including traditional and media. You understand urgency of deadline. You continually strive to meet or exceed expectations in all aspects of your role, from supporting client accounts to proactively contributing and collaborating with the team. You have a solid understanding of digital marketing.


**Responsibilities**


* Attain working knowledge of Team Velocity’s processes, account management, integrated strategies and our proprietary technology platform, Apollo®
* Assist with preparation of Customer Success documents, i.e., meeting agendas, reporting decks, and general Client communications
* Participate in and document Client meeting discussions and conference calls
* Maintain constant communication with Account Teams on deliverables’ status and current work\-in\-progress using internal processes
* Assist with resolving Client questions and needs in a timely manner
* Work to problem\-solve production issues and errors; escalate issues, as needed
* Understand Clients’ goals and effectively organize deliverables to ensure productive campaign results
* Problem solve production issues and resolve in a timely manner
* Update and maintain Clients’ Consumer Portal(s)
* Learn, and maintain, knowledge of compliance and co\-op requirements for all in program manufacturers (Ford and Lincoln)
* Support Account Management team with additional tasks, as needed
* Work ahead on client deliverables; *what you know in advance, do in advance*
* Shares responsibility for 100% Client retention by working with the team to maintain client relationships, proactively identifying client risks or opportunities
* Be a positive, proactive, and productive brand team member


**Additional Responsibilities**

* Know your Client! Learn, and maintain, knowledge of Client Accounts; understand their Perfect Market
* Be a student of the Industry! Hone your understanding of the automotive industry, company culture, products, services, strategic communication planning and integrated marketing strategies
* Exercise proactive daily communications in a professional and efficient manner, with both colleagues and clients
* Continually seek ways to add value to the Client / Agency relationship


**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or related field
* A minimum of 0\-2 years’ professional experience
* Agency experience, *preferred*
* Automotive Agency, Automotive In\-House Marketing and/or Customer Service experience, *preferred*
* Proficient in Microsoft Office
* Extremely organized, task and detailed\-oriented
* Must be a critical thinker
* Exceptional communication skills, demonstrated ability to write, listen and articulate in a clear, concise, and professional manner
* Demonstrated ability to proactively take ownership of projects
* Ability to establish priorities and objectives
* Must be flexible in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment
* Must maintain focus and constructive behavior under pressure


**Compensation**  

This entry\-level position offers a starting salary of $48,000 annually, commensurate with experience, plus variable opportunity, as well as participation in company benefits offerings including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, wellness, and more.


**Next Steps**  

If you are interested in this position and believe your experience is a perfect fit, please COMPLETE the online application.Please be sure to include a current resume along with your contact information. Incomplete submissions will not be considered. No phone calls please.


**ABOUT TEAM VELOCITY**  

Team Velocity is revolutionizing the automotive industry with cutting\-edge technology to help dealers sell and service more cars. Made by dealers for dealers, Team Velocity’s proprietary technology platform Apollo® analyzes consumer behavior to predict who will buy, what they will buy, and when they are ready to service. Apollo automates the entire communication process by delivering hyper\-personalized campaigns across every touchpoint, maximizing ROI, and lifetime revenue. Our vision is to serve our clients with a single technology platform that empowers them to execute intelligent marketing across every online and offline channel. We aim to deliver a frictionless consumer experience, from the initial engagement to a final transaction.

As part of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with more than 20 years of experience, we’re focused on building simple, responsible financial solutions that put people first. Job Description
Job Description


\*\*\* **This role is a PPC role\*\*\***

Purchasing Power is a leading employee purchase program that helps people buy the products and services they need through the convenience of payroll deduction. As part of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with more than 20 years of experience, we’re focused on building simple, responsible financial solutions that put people first. PROG Holdings’ portfolio includes Progressive Leasing, a market leader in lease‑to‑own solutions, Purchasing Power, and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform — all united by a commitment to innovation, access, and meaningful impact.


Learn more at purchasingpower.com


We are hiring a **Strategic Account Manager** that will serve as the trusted advisor and primary liaison to clients and brokers with the objectives of initiating and cultivating successful partnerships between Purchasing Power and key client accounts and brokers. The SAE will be responsible for the overall management of internal activities of a growing book of accounts within designated broker and client territories. This role will be accountable for the growth and increased profitability of existing business, assisting the acquisition of new business, and the strategic direction of assigned accounts and broker partnerships.


*This is a hybrid role that requires in‑office presence in Atlanta, Georgia.*

**What You Will Do:**

* Meet target revenue and revenue per eligible rates for each assigned account
* Represent Purchasing Power at the executive level of our clients and brokers to build strong relationships and be able to educate each audience (broker, client, and consumer) of our value proposition
* Proactively offer guidance to help educate our broker and client partners for needed training programs
* Expand and cultivate each account and assigned broker region through frequent visits, ongoing communication, and accurate reporting
* Develop marketing opportunities for promotion to maximize program effectiveness for each account, utilizing broker portals and other communication tools available
* Ensure that account contract terms are adhered to and that all account needs are addressed
* Provide insight and information to cross\-functional internal departments to assist SAE to become a valuable resource and partner
* Understand of account industry trends as well as voluntary benefit trends to identity new business opportunities with client and broker partners
* Proactively identify and report potential risks associated with each client and broker
* Effectively identify and partner with brokers to execute any upsell opportunities
* Optimize client and broker experience across sales, client services, marketing, and customer experience
* Serve as account owner and decision maker on relationship affecting issues/escalations
* Develop strategic recommendation for continual improvement and expansion of client and broker relationships
* Document new processes/policies/procedures relating to the client and oversees training on these to applicable internal staff

**The Experience You Will Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business or related field or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5\+ years of Account management experience
* Experience with managing employee benefit offerings / programs
* Possess financial acumen, analytical and operations skills
* Experience using Microsoft Office products (Pivot tables, Power Point, etc)
* Experience using CRM tools (Salesforce)
* Able to travel as needed for client stewardships, benefit fairs, client/broker, and events
* Proven annual goal attainment
* Superior written and oral communication skills and excellent presentation skills
* Strong time management and organizational skills; ability to maintain a high quality of work in a deadline driven environment
* AI\-enabled tools are already part of how work gets done across our organization, and their use will continue to expand over time. We value people who are curious, adaptable, and open to learning as roles and workflows evolve.
* Ability to build relationships \& network both internally and externally
* Ability to work in\-office 3 days a week
* Ability to travel 35% of the time
*Purchasing Power welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, age, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Purchasing Power does business.*

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description** Big Green Machinery Inc. is a growing industrial equipment and automation company serving customers across the United States. As an authorized U.S. distributor of HELI Forklift and PUDU Robotics, the company provides material handling equipment, industrial robotics, and automation solutions to a wide range of industries. Its product portfolio includes forklifts, service robots, and other automation technologies that help businesses improve productivity, efficiency, and operational performance. Big Green Machinery focuses on understanding each customer’s operational needs and delivering practical, long\-term solutions. The company is committed to building strong relationships with customers, dealers, and partners while offering reliable equipment, innovative technology, and responsive support.

**Role Description** The Sales Account Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Atlanta, GA. This position is responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of customer accounts, including developing relationships with new and existing clients across industrial and commercial sectors. Day\-to\-day tasks include identifying sales opportunities, conducting product presentations and demonstrations, preparing quotes and proposals, and negotiating terms to close deals. The Sales Account Manager will track sales activity, maintain accurate CRM records, and collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely delivery, after\-sales support, and high customer satisfaction. The role also involves participating in lead generation activities, attending industry events when needed, and providing ongoing account support to drive repeat business and long\-term partnerships.

**Qualifications**

* Customer\-focused capabilities, including Customer Satisfaction and Customer Service skills, to build trust and maintain strong relationships.
* Account Management experience, with the ability to oversee multiple customer accounts, track performance, and identify growth opportunities.
* Lead Generation skills, including prospecting, qualifying opportunities, and developing targeted outreach strategies.
* Strong Communication skills, both written and verbal, to deliver clear product information, proposals, and negotiations.
* Previous experience in B2B sales, preferably in industrial equipment, material handling, automation, or related sectors.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and basic office software (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, email tools).
* Ability to work on\-site in Atlanta, GA, visit customer locations as needed, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a results\-oriented approach to meeting sales targets.

Please submit resume to **sales@bgmamerica.com** or contact us directly through LinkedIn.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Mileage reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Landscape Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Work With The Best**
----------------------


We are building the premier outdoor living company in the country by creating a “family of family companies” across the nation. Now you can build your landscaping career with the best, working in one of our many company locations nationwide. Learn from the top experts in the field and work on some of the country’s largest and most complex landscape projects. Take advantage of opportunities to share and exchange best practices across our network. The opportunities are endless.

**About Us:** At Ed Castro Landscape, we are redefining luxury outdoor living through innovative design, precision installation, and exceptional maintenance services. Serving the Greater Atlanta area, we specialize in creating sophisticated, sustainable landscapes for high\-end residential and commercial clients. Our team is driven by craftsmanship, attention to detail, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction.

**Position Summary:** Ed Castro Landscape is hiring a Landscape Account Manager to join the team. The Account Manager (Client Representative) plays a critical role in delivering an elevated client experience while driving operational excellence and profitability. This is a highly visible, client\-facing position that blends relationship management, field operations, horticultural expertise, and leadership.


The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation environment and is passionate about delivering best\-in\-class landscape solutions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Client \& Account Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned landscape maintenance clients
* Conduct regular property inspections to ensure quality, identify needs, and maintain contract compliance
* Develop and present proposals, enhancements, and detailed cost estimates
* Coordinate services from proposal through execution with accuracy and timeliness
* Maintain proactive, professional communication to exceed client expectations
* Support billing, collections, and documentation for maintenance and enhancement services

**Team Leadership \& Operations**

* Oversee landscape maintenance crews through effective leadership of a Production Manager
* Train, coach, and develop team members on safety, quality standards, and best practices
* Perform routine quality control visits to ensure work meets company and client standards
* Manage schedules and workflows to maintain efficiency and service excellence
* Ensure accurate documentation for contracts, enhancements, and site updates
* Troubleshoot field challenges and implement timely, effective solutions

**Horticulture \& Technical Expertise**

* Apply strong knowledge of Georgia plant material, turf management, and seasonal care practices
* Read and interpret landscape plans, blueprints, and site specifications
* Oversee proper use of fertilizers, pest control, and disease management programs
* Diagnose and manage irrigation systems
* Support installation and maintenance of low\-voltage landscape lighting

**Sales \& Profitability**

* Achieve or exceed revenue and profitability targets for assigned accounts
* Identify and develop opportunities for enhancements and additional services
* Monitor budgets and contribute to job costing and P\&L performance
* Maintain accurate estimating, tracking, and billing records

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in landscape account management or operations
* Strong horticultural knowledge, preferably within Georgia or similar climates
* Valid, clean driver’s license
* Industry certifications (e.g., Georgia Certified Landscape Professional) preferred
* Experience with industry software (Aspire, CompanyCam, GeoTab) and Microsoft Office
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus
* Strong communication, leadership, and organizational skills
* Ability to read and interpret site plans and maintenance specifications

**THE PERKS:**

* 401(k) with company match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* FSA / HSA options
* Life and long\-term disability insurance
* Paid time off
* Tuition reimbursement (after one year of service)
* Employee perks and discount programs
